Abstract: Cross-view object correspondence (CVOC) aims to establish associations of the same target between query and search videos captured from different viewpoints. Existing methods often rely on visual cues for CVOC. Despite recent progress, these methods struggle in complicated scenarios with substantial viewpoint changes and appearance variations, due to lacking sufficient target information. Addressing this, we introduce TeSCo, a framework that exploits rich Textual Semantics of an object, in addition to its visual cues, for cross-view object Correspondence. Our key insight is, textual description of a target, by capturing diverse attributes such as category, texture, and color, provides viewpoint- and appearance-invariant semantics, which are complementary to visual cues and can hence enhance correspondence robustness in complicated scenes. Inspired by this, TeSCo first generates a textual expression of the target from the given query view using a vision-language model, and then extracts textual feature to enhance visual features for localization in the search view. To realize this, we introduce a text-conditioned cross-modal fusion (TCF) module that incorporates the textual feature into visual features with text-guided modulation, producing more robust multimodal target representation for object correspondence. Since not all textual cues are equally compatible with the target in current search-view frame, we propose an iterative textual feature refinement (ITFR) module that progressively adjusts textual feature using search-view information before the TCF module, enabling search-view-aware textual semantics to be fused into visual features and leading to better performance. In extensive experiments on Ego-Exo4D and HANDAL-X, TeSCo demonstrates state-of-the-art results and largely outperforms other models, validating its efficacy. Our code is released at https://github.com/VAIL-Fan/TeSCo.

Abstract: In virtual environments, choosing appropriate outfits requires contextual harmony with surrounding scenes, yet bridging the visual gap between 3D ambient views and catalog garment assets remains challenging. This paper investigates scene-conditioned outfit retrieval for interactive 3D environments, where a user’s egocentric view serves as the retrieval signal. We present GEAR (Generative Editing for Asset Retrieval), a framework that bridges the cross-domain gap by synthesizing intermediate visual queries rather than predicting direct compatibility. GEAR uses a vision-language model to describe suitable clothing from a captured scene, employs an instruction-guided diffusion model to render the concept onto a standardized reference character, and utilizes the cropped clothing region to retrieve existing 2D outfit assets via embedding similarity. We benchmark GEAR against direct visual similarity, aesthetic scoring, and VLM-based reranking on a controlled dataset using automated Swiss-system pairwise judgments, where GEAR achieves competitive top-ranked performance (mean Elo@5 of 1012.75 and top-10 overlap of 0.180) alongside 0.539 pairwise agreement. Abstract: Inertial sensors are moving into clothing, from sensorized sportswear to garments instrumented with hundreds of IMUs. Sewn into clothing, a sensor no longer moves rigidly with the body: loose fabric slides, twists and swings, so a garment-mounted sensor records the motion of the fabric as well as that of the body, and this extra motion differs from one garment to the next. Models for such sensors need training data recorded with the deployed garment, yet labeled data are scarce. IMUdrape synthesizes motion from activity descriptions, reconstructs the target garment as a sewing pattern from photographs, places virtual IMUs at the deployment’s real sensor positions, and simulates the garment with an intersection-free contact solver, so that every simulation yields paired garment and body signals. With one real subject, its data improve recognition macro-F1 by 7% to 46% over real data alone and by 2% to 11% over body-mounted virtual data from the same motion. Abstract: 3-D road anomaly segmentation is essential for risk-aware perception in autonomous driving. Abstract: Jointly trained multimodal networks frequently underutilize weaker modalities, as faster-learning modalities dominate the shared fusion objective and suppress gradients reaching slower ones. Abstract: Widespread image sharing on social media has increased the need for visual privacy recognition to identify inadvertently exposed privacy information. However, multi-label visual privacy recognition presents two challenges. First, privacy categories represent high-level semantic attributes and do not have a one-to-one correspondence with visual objects. Different visual objects may involve the same privacy category, while the same type of object may contain different types of privacy-sensitive information. In this setting, direct prediction methods generally lack explicit guidance for identifying category-relevant privacy cues, leaving this process implicit in the learned image-to-label mapping and potentially limiting classification performance. Second, privacy cues are often distributed across image regions and may not be adequately represented by whole-image features. To address these challenges, we propose Privacy Concept Bottleneck Models (PriCBMs). By introducing privacy-related concepts as intermediate semantic representations, PriCBMs first identify category-relevant privacy cues through visual-concept matching and then predict privacy categories based on concept responses. This process makes privacy predictions more interpretable. To improve the quality of these concepts, we design a concept selection strategy based on target-category relevance, cross-category discriminability, and semantic diversity. Meanwhile, we introduce a global-region modeling module to capture localized privacy evidence while retaining global context. Experiments on VISPR and FineViP show that PriCBMs outperform evaluated competitors across all four multi-label metrics. Abstract: Joint nuclei instance segmentation and classification requires precise boundaries and neighborhood information that helps distinguish morphologically similar cell types. Abstract: Skeleton-based action recognition is a pivotal task in computer vision; however, conventional Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs) are often constrained by pairwise joint modeling, which fails to capture the intricate high-order interactions inherent in human movement. At the core of DyGCN is the Dynamic Hypergraph Construction Network with Contrastive Score Refinement (DyGCT) block, which comprises two novel components: the Geometry-Constrained Dynamic Hypergraph Construction (GeoHC) module and the Contrastive Score Refinement (CSR) module. Specifically, GeoHC dynamically constructs action-specific hyperedges by leveraging geometry-constrained second-order compatibility, transcending the limitations of static hyperedge structures. Furthermore, CSR explicitly refines the pairwise compatibility scores during hypergraph construction through prototype-based contrastive learning, fostering more discriminative action-specific hyperedges, with zero inference-time overhead as CSR operates only during training. Extensive experiments on NTU RGB+D, NTU RGB+D 120, and Northwestern-UCLA validate the effectiveness of DyGCN, achieving state-of-the-art performance on widely used benchmarks. Abstract: Semantic granularity, which refers to the levels at which visual representations organize image content into meaningful entities, is fundamental to image understanding. However, whether pretrained visual representations inherently encode semantic structures at multiple granularities remains poorly understood. This paper presents a representation-driven approach for discovering semantically meaningful image regions at different granularities through clustering of pretrained visual representations without semantic supervision. Specifically, we concatenate selected feature maps extracted from a pretrained visual model and apply a singular value decomposition (SVD)-based projection to derive pixel-wise principal representation maps (PRMs). The resulting PRMs capture implicit semantic structures embedded in pretrained visual representations, making them accessible to subsequent semantic clustering. We then introduce the semantic continuity rate (SCR), based on the silhouette principle, to quantify the coherence of pixel-wise representations within and between clusters at different candidate granularities. Furthermore, we analyze the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of SCR profiles to assess representation suitability for discovering semantic regions at multiple granularities. Our results indicate that PRMs exhibiting higher SNR values over an initial range of cluster numbers tend to yield more semantically meaningful regions across multiple granularities. We evaluate the proposed approach on the COCO-2017 and VOC-2012 validation datasets using Hungarian-matched intersection over union (HIoU). The results demonstrate competitive segmentation performance among the compared methods, supporting the feasibility of discovering useful semantic granularities through clustering PRMs without semantic supervision.

Abstract: Supervised low-light image and video enhancement has achieved remarkable progress, yet current models remain fundamentally constrained by the limitations of existing datasets. Furthermore, capturing dynamic paired sequences without introducing warping artifacts or sensor-specific biases remains an open challenge. Abstract: End-to-end autonomous driving policies require effective visual representations that capture both spatial scene structure and temporal dynamics. We study action-free video latent prediction as a scalable pretraining objective and introduce ScaleDrive, a driving-oriented framework pretrained exclusively on large-scale internet open-world driving videos, without action annotations or benchmark-specific data. We keep the pretrained video encoder frozen during downstream end-to-end planning training to isolate the transferability of representations learned from internet driving videos. Ego-motion and depth probes show that scaling action-free video pretraining progressively strengthens the temporal and geometric information encoded in the frozen representation. We systematically study the visual representation transfer across different end-to-end driving policies and closed-loop benchmarks, where ScaleDrive consistently improves downstream performance and demonstrates that scaling action-free video latent prediction yields representations that generalize across both planning policy architectures and evaluation scenarios and protocols.

Abstract: Classical structure-from-motion reconstruction proceeds iteratively, refining camera poses and scene geometry from a current estimate. This allows maps to easily expand without recomputing already computed views, or geometry estimates to improve as more observations are provided. Most geometric foundation models, however, predict entire geometry in a single forward pass or update a recurrent state as frames arrive sequentially, making this expansion and refinement non-trivial. We introduce Solv3R, a looped transformer that learns to continue solving multi-view geometry from its current state. Importantly, its update operator is independent of the iteration count, allowing previously refined and newly introduced views to be jointly updated regardless of how ``solved’’ they are. We train the operator to preserve accurate reconstructions under continued iteration and correct inaccurate states, enabling refinement of fixed image collections and integration of new observations. Representations of solved views can also be cached once and reused as geometric context across iterations, enabling compact and efficient key-value caching. We analyze the solver dynamics and compare it with the state-of-the-art, demonstrating that a single learned solver supports offline reconstruction, incremental reconstruction, relocalization, and streaming without task-specific training or modules. The code and models will be made publicly available at https://ubc-vision.github.io/solv3r/.

Result: 在标准 benchmark 上，ProtoFusion 提升了定量性能，在美学评价中取得较好结果，并生成视觉连贯的融合输出。摘要未给出具体数据集名称和数值指标。

Abstract: Infrared and visible image fusion integrates complementary information from both modalities to provide a more comprehensive representation of the scene. We propose ProtoFusion, a protocol-guided generative framework for infrared and visible image fusion. Instead of relying on fixed fusion operators, hand-crafted objectives, or manually specified one-shot prompts, ProtoFusion formulates fusion as protocol-constrained generation. It represents fusion intent with a structured protocol, consisting of environment state cards, grounding principles, and a style profile, which explicitly specifies which evidence should be preserved or suppressed and which properties the fused result should satisfy. To optimize this protocol, we introduce protocol-guided prompt refinement, a closed-loop learning framework that iteratively performs generation, evaluation, and revision under multimodal evidence. Once learned, the optimized protocol is fixed at inference time and directly guides fusion generation. To address residual source inconsistencies, we further incorporate structured belief construction, which organizes modality reliability, scene evidence, and cross-modal conflicts into a structured representation for conservative correction after generation. Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks show that ProtoFusion improves quantitative performance, achieves favorable results in aesthetic evaluation, and produces visually coherent fusion outputs. Project Page: {https://erfect2020.github.io/ProtoFusion/}.

Abstract: Traditional image cropping assumes the photograph already contains the composition worth keeping, and asks only where to crop. A full 360$^{\circ}$ scene offers no such guarantee: the viewing direction in a scene has to be discovered before anything can be framed. We present PhotoGuider, a measure-then-frame method that answers both questions with compact learned scorers over one shared set of composition-aware features. The designed features are extracted using foundation and task-specific vision models and structured into four photographic tokens: Subject, Composition, Aesthetics, and Integrity. Our MLLM explainer is fine-tuned to generate composition-related explanations conditioned on images and measured token assessments. To our knowledge, PhotoGuider is the first method to combine explicit composition-based direction selection in 360$^{\circ}$ panoramas with refined framing, camera-parameter output for native re-rendering, and measurement-conditioned explanations. On two standard 2D cropping benchmarks, PhotoGuider achieves the highest average mIoU performance against ground-truth crops. In a blind ranking study, 120 participants ranked three cropping methods over 100 panoramic scenes from the public Poly Haven HDRI library, placing our framings first in 53.2% of cases, against 27.3% and 19.5% for two strong alternatives. Project page: https://ntuneillee.github.io/research/photoguider/

Motivation: 现有3D人体姿态估计方法在标准基准上精度高，但在真实健身锻炼场景下的性能研究不足，且单目与多视角方法的权衡以及时间后处理对时序一致性的改进效果缺乏系统评估。

Abstract: Three-dimensional human pose estimation has become a fundamental component of computer vision systems for sports analytics, rehabilitation, and motion understanding. Although recent deep learning approaches have achieved remarkable accuracy on standard benchmarks, their performance under realistic sports scenarios remains insufficiently studied. Furthermore, the trade-offs between recent monocular and multi-view approaches, as well as the benefits of post-processing techniques for improving temporal consistency, have not been systematically evaluated on fitness-oriented datasets. This paper evaluates recent state-of-the-art 3D human pose estimation methods on Fit3D, a dataset of synchronized multi-view recordings of a wide variety of fitness exercises with accurate ground-truth annotations. We study two recent monocular lifting approaches, TCPFormer and PoseMamba-L, and a multi-view model, MVGFormer, under a unified evaluation protocol. To investigate the influence of the input data, monocular methods are evaluated using ground-truth keypoints and detections generated by recent 2D pose estimators, RTMPose and YOLO-Pose. Additionally, we analyze the effectiveness of three temporal filters for reducing prediction jitter while preserving motion dynamics. Experimental results provide a detailed comparison of accuracy, temporal consistency, and robustness to imperfect 2D detections across the evaluated methods. Our analysis highlights the impact of detector quality on lifting-based approaches, compares transformer- and state-space-based temporal architectures, and discusses the practical trade-offs between monocular and multi-view systems for fitness motion analysis. Our results show that 2D detection quality, temporal modeling, and post-processing must be considered jointly in pose estimation pipelines for exercise analysis.

Abstract: Pose-driven human video diffusion animates a person from a single reference image and a target pose sequence, yet it struggles to preserve identity, rendering the face and garments unfaithfully as the pose departs from it. Instead, we synthesize the missing supervision. A domain-tuned, pose-conditioned generator produces pseudo-ground-truth frames at selected key poses. An inference-time reference-only sampler steers these candidates toward the subject and keeps the most identity-consistent. Although lower in fidelity, these synthetic frames supervise more effectively than real ones. Real frames as captured carry motion that erodes the temporal prior, while a static clip conveys appearance alone. On TikTok and UBC Fashion, the adapted model improves the base on every metric, inverts the identity-versus-motion trade-off, and matches or surpasses adaptation on five real frames despite using none. Abstract: With the popularization of livestreaming applications, automatic camera tuning has become indispensable for ordinary users to enjoy high Quality of Experience (QoE). However, the existing Image Quality Assessment (IQA) methods face two challenges in camera tuning. First, they struggle to identify subtle quality difference between images, which is common in camera tuning. Second, the ability to explain fine-grained differences and to provide suggestions for camera tuning are even more lacking. To address these challenges, we first construct FGLive-Comments, an instruction tuning dataset with rich annotations of both preferences for fine-grained image pairs and quality reasoning from global and local visual evidence, which supports selective adjustment recommendations of camera parameters. Based on FGLive-Comments, we develop Q-CamTuning, a multimodal large language model for livestreaming camera tuning. Its progressive perception-evidence-guidance framework learns quality-aware visual representations, enhances fine-grained reasoning with global-local evidence, and maps quality issues to camera-parameter adjustment directions. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that Q-CamTuning outperforms existing IQA models in both quality scoring and fine-grained image pair ranking. User study also validates its ability to recommend camera tuning suggestions.

Abstract: Numerous distillation methods have been developed to accelerate diffusion models. Recent research indicates that hybrid strategies—blending different paradigms—yield superior results compared to single-method approaches. However, current works predominantly rely on a simple combination of objectives, leaving the question of how to effectively synergize them largely underexplored. In this paper, we specifically investigate the synergy between Score Distillation and Adversarial Distillation. We reveal that their operating zones are distinct and complementary: Score Distillation is effective in high-noise regimes for capturing the global distribution yet lacks fine-grained supervision in low-noise regions. Conversely, Adversarial Distillation is effective in low-noise regions but is prone to instability and suffers from discriminator failure when applied to high-noise intervals. Leveraging this insight, we propose Efficient Adversarial Score Distillation (EASD), a framework that synergizes these objectives via a regime-adaptive sampling strategy, directing each objective to focus on its effective interval. We further apply this paradigm to DiT-based Flow Matching models. Empirically, our method achieves a promising one-step FID of 1.39 on ImageNet 256$\times$256 using the SiT-XL/2+REPA model. This work provides a concrete guideline for maximizing the potential of hybrid distillation. Our code and model are available at https://github.com/pf0607/EASD .

Abstract: Misleading charts can lead vision-language models to conclusions that conflict with underlying data. Existing work focuses on inference-time strategies, while training-time supervision remains less explored. We present VizDAGuide, a DAG-structured supervision method for misleading-chart question answering. The method represents intermediate reasoning states and their dependencies as a directed acyclic graph, assigns supervision weights according to their roles, and serializes the graph into a unified training target for open-ended and multiple-choice QA with single-pass inference. Experiments on two benchmarks across Qwen3-VL and InternVL3.5 models show improvements over a content- and weight-matched Linear CoT-SFT baseline on both answer formats. Process-level evaluation shows gains in grounding and operation execution, while ablations indicate that dependency structure and weighted supervision are most effective when combined. These results support DAG-structured weighted supervision for misleading-chart question answering.

Abstract: Cloth-changing person re-identification (CC-ReID) is still very challenging, and no method clearly dominates: methods that lead on one benchmark collapse on the others, because they rest on different identity cues. We show that a general-purpose vision-language model (VLM), used zero-shot as a judge for reranking a short candidate list, beats the expert retrieval models it reranks by a wide and consistent margin. On the four scenarios of CHIRLA, a long-term CC-ReID benchmark that no publicly released Re-ID model is trained on, reranking the candidates of two frozen experts raises rank-1 on every scenario, by 12.9 points on average over the best expert and 9.4 over the best naive ensemble of the two, with no component fine-tuned on the target data. Merging both experts’ shortlists matches or beats reranking the stronger expert’s shortlist alone, at lower cost. Introducing a VLM does, however, come at a cost: almost all of the pipeline’s FLOPs are spent on it. We therefore borrow a criterion from ensembling and invoke the VLM judge only where the two experts disagree at rank 1. This threshold-free gate removes 40% of the calls, and a comparable share of total compute, with no significant drop in rank-1, trading 1.8 to 3.8 points of mAP. Judging remains the dominant cost, but on a benchmark where dedicated experts stall, we find a frozen general-purpose model to be the strongest judge of identity. The code is available at https://github.com/bdager/JudgeReID.

Abstract: We present a GPU-native volumetric-video system for real-time reconstruction of graphics-compatible textured triangle meshes from multiple RGB-D sensors. Existing TSDF systems accelerate fusion and mesh extraction, but extending them to per-frame textured meshing adds CPU mesh processing, CPU-side texturing work, or extra CPU-GPU transfers between stages. After input staging, our method keeps the reconstruction and texturing stages (TSDF fusion, Marching Cubes, connected-component noise removal, view-based texture mapping, inpainting, and radiometric seam correction) resident on the GPU; no intermediate mesh or image data returns to the host between these stages. A fixed-size-array representation of mesh topology gives constant-time neighbor access on the GPU and makes the downstream mesh-level operations data-parallel. Because we texture each face from a single camera, exposure seams that vary smoothly across each image remain; we estimate a per-camera low-frequency gain field and bake it into the atlas on the GPU. On the CMU Panoptic dataset, our method is faster than the baselines at every tested voxel resolution and number of sensors, achieves peak speedups of more than an order of magnitude over CUDA-accelerated nvblox and CPU-based Open3D, and approaches an offline textured-meshing baseline in perceptual re-rendering quality.

Abstract: Adaptive compressed sensing (CS) aims to select the most informative measurements sequentially, which is crucial for many modern imaging systems. This task can be formulated as a Bayesian sequential optimal experimental design (sOED) problem, where each new acquisition is chosen to maximally reduce uncertainty about the unknown image given prior information and subsequent data provided by acquisitions. However, in single-pixel imaging (SPI), the large design space consists of all possible binary illumination patterns. Directly optimizing the Bayesian sOED objective over this space using conventional methods is generally challenging. In this work, we reformulate sOED for SPI as a reinforcement learning (RL) problem. In RL, an agent learns a policy through repeated experimental trials to maximize a reward, here given as the expected information gain, the most complete measure of uncertainty reduction in Bayesian OED. This avoids the need to directly optimize complex information-theoretic objectives during a measurement to obtain the next design. Instead, the result is a learned policy function that directly maps the current posterior belief about the image to the next optimal binary measurement pattern, in a computationally efficient way. Using a simple yet representative SPI imaging scenario, this work evaluates the scalability of the learned policy under two different policy parameterizations. Furthermore, we investigate how performance deteriorates when only approximate posterior information is available or the measurements are impaired by noise, and propose several strategies to introduce additional design constraints motivated by biomedical applications. The numerical experiments demonstrate that the proposed Bayesian sOED-RL framework remains robust and can be extended to more complex, large-scale SPI scenarios.

Motivation: 复杂视频编辑需要理解复杂指令并同时满足多个编辑请求，而通过密集模型缩放来提升能力会显著增加计算成本。因此，需要一种高效扩展模型容量的方法。

Abstract: Complex video editing requires understanding complex instructions while jointly fulfilling multiple editing requests. Meeting these demands through dense model scaling substantially increases computational cost. We introduce VideoEditor-MoE, the first open-source mixture-of-experts framework for video editing. Beyond sparse MLP-MoE layers, MoE-Attention expands attention capacity through routed key–value experts while preserving global interactions among video tokens. Initialized from a 5B video editing model, VideoEditor-MoE scales to 14B and 56B parameters, with approximately 8B parameters activated per token in both variants. Comparisons with existing methods and two complementary baselines, Explicit-MoE and MLP-MoE, assess its benefits over explicit expert guidance and MLP-only expert architectures. Further analyses demonstrate that all experts remain active and reveal that learned routing responds more strongly to sample content and diffusion noise levels than to human-defined editing categories. Spatial analysis further indicates sensitivity to object-level semantic features. We also identify decoupled weight decay as a strategy for stabilizing expert scaling.

Abstract: Image-text corpora contain copies of one image, captions that describe one image in different ways, captions reused for different images, and captions that do not match their images. Each case calls for a different curation action. Deduplication and multimodal entity resolution (ER) only decide whether records are the same, and they are evaluated on labeled pairs. Yet pair scores do not tell which records end up in the same cluster or which useful captions get deleted. We therefore formulate image-text deduplication as graded multimodal ER, which decides visual identity, caption handling, and mismatches for each pair, and we evaluate it at three levels: pairs, clusters, and the retained set. Our method, VL-Dedup, groups records of the same visual entity into clusters and caps the size of each cluster. Within each cluster, a vision-language model (VLM) and CLIPScore decide which captions to keep and which to flag. We also build VL-DedupBench, with 50,000 COCO and SOP records and 66,788 labeled pairs. On it, a classifier that selects no false edge among the labeled pairs still joins millions of record pairs from different entities. Spending VLM calls on the pairs inside clusters, rather than on pairs with uncertain scores, gives better caption decisions from the same model. Even when almost all clusters are correct, keeping one record per cluster loses facts in many deletions, while the deletions of VL-Dedup lose much less information.

Abstract: While Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has significantly advanced multimodal reasoning, existing frameworks suffer from a critical “perception-reasoning gap.” Due to an over-reliance on seemingly relevant visual tokens, even minor perceptual perturbations can propagate through the reasoning process, leading to compounding hallucinations. To address this issue, we propose MIRA, a training framework that improves robustness to erroneous visual contexts while enhancing logical reasoning ability. By injecting filtered, deceptive visual contexts during training, we construct challenging “hard traps” that stress-test the model’s robustness to misleading information. Furthermore, we introduce a group-wise reflection-triggering mechanism that enables the model to autonomously detect and rectify inconsistencies between visual cues and logical constraints, which is ultimately internalized as an intrinsic policy behavior. Importantly, MIRA does not rely on human annotations. Experimental results across multiple reasoning and perception benchmarks show that MIRA yields an average 7% improvement on in-domain benchmarks, with consistent improvements on vision-centric benchmarks. These findings highlight that active error recovery is essential for robust multimodal reasoning. Comprehensive ablation studies and analyses further provide insights into why MIRA is effective.

Abstract: Complex documents such as scientific papers contain rich information in tables, figures, and equations; however, existing deep research (DR) agents typically reduce papers to OCR-extracted text. We instead ask whether vision-language models (VLMs) can enable page-native deep research: directly retrieving and reasoning over rendered document page images. We introduce DR Pixel, the first open-source end-to-end multimodal DR agent that uses rendered page images as its sole retrieval and reasoning unit, operating over a corpus of 1.06M pages. To evaluate this setting, we construct DRPixelBench, a benchmark on scientific papers requiring reasoning over text, figures, tables, and equations. Surprisingly, page-native DR already works well without training, outperforming OCR-based baselines across state-of-the-art models like GPT-5.4, Gemini-3.5-Flash, and Qwen3.6-27B, while requiring fewer tool calls. We next turn to DR training. A key challenge is that teacher trajectories for agentic supervised finetuning are noisy, mixing critical reasoning and action steps with redundant or failed attempts. To address this, we introduce counterfactual credit reweighting, a fine-grained credit assignment method that weights individual reasoning and action steps by their counterfactual contribution to the final answer. Our training improves retrieval recall by about 15 points and final accuracy by over 10 points on DRPixelBench, and likewise outperforms the untrained baseline on four existing benchmarks. On out-of-distribution ViDoRe-V3, DR Pixel comes within 1.8 points of an oracle that is given the gold pages directly. Our results suggest that the conventional OCR-then-retrieve pipeline is not only unnecessary but suboptimal: directly retrieving and reasoning over visual document pages makes complex DR both more effective and more efficient.

Motivation: 现有 SCR 方法虽然紧凑、准确且快速，但在不同相机模型间泛化较差，如全向或强矫正图像。视场、镜头畸变或矫正重采样会使同一场景内容因像素位置不同而外观变化，从而降低定位精度。

Result: 作者在多种 SCR 架构以及包含针孔、鱼眼和全向相机的数据集上评估 Ray-SCR。射线条件化显著提升跨相机泛化能力，并在这些挑战性跨相机设置下取得 state-of-the-art 定位性能。

Insight: 创新点在于将标定视线作为特征条件、用浅层局部 Transformer 聚合邻域射线特征，并在射线空间监督，同时利用稀疏 SfM 点作为跨视角和跨相机模型的度量锚点，从而实现单一场景表示对异构相机查询图像的准确定位。

Abstract: Among visual localization strategies, scene coordinate regression (SCR) has emerged as an attractive approach for its compactness, accuracy, and speed. Despite these advantages, SCR models generalize poorly across substantially different camera models, such as omnidirectional or strongly rectified imagery. This limitation arises because, changes in field of view, lens distortion, or rectification-induced resampling can make the same scene content appear differently depending on its pixel position, degrading localization accuracy. To cope with this limitation, we introduce Ray-SCR, a lightweight extension to existing SCR architectures that conditions local visual features on their calibrated viewing rays and refines neighboring ray-conditioned features with a shallow local Transformer. We further formulate supervision directly in ray space and use sparse SfM points as metric anchors that link observations across views and camera models. Taken together, these components enable a single scene representation built from a panoramic mapping sequence to accurately localize query images captured with very different cameras, including pinhole, fisheye, and omnidirectional cameras. We evaluate Ray-SCR across multiple SCR architectures and on datasets with pinhole, fisheye, and omnidirectional cameras. The proposed ray conditioning substantially improves generalization across cameras and leads to state-of-the-art localization performance in these challenging cross-camera settings. The project page is available at https://jaeminch0.github.io/ray-scr-generalizing-scene-coordinate-regression-across-camera-models/.

[226] Multimodal Prompt Learning with Dual-Granularity Contrastive Alignment for Preoperative Prediction of Lung Adenocarcinoma Invasiveness Using 3D CT cs.CV | cs.AIPDF

TL;DR: 论文提出一种面向3D CT肺腺癌侵袭性术前预测的多模态提示学习框架，通过报告级与关键词级的双粒度图像-文本对齐，将临床报告语义监督引入CT分类。模型在推理阶段仅需CT图像，实现对浸润性腺癌（IAD）与Pre-IAD病变的区分。

Details

Motivation: 肺腺癌侵袭性术前准确判断对手术规划和个体化治疗很重要，但IAD与Pre-IAD在CT表现上存在重叠，仅靠图像难以区分，因此需要利用放射报告语义增强CT表征学习。

Result: 在1593个病理确认结节上测试，准确率87.92%、F1为87.78%、AUC为0.9499；AUC显著优于同视觉主干的仅图像Res-CBAM基线（0.9297，DeLong检验p=0.0078），消融实验支持全局/局部对齐及报告提示初始化的贡献。

Insight: 创新点在于双粒度图像-文本对齐：全局对比对齐提供整体语义监督，基于多实例学习的局部对齐关联空间CT特征与血管相关放射关键词；同时用真实临床报告语义初始化可学习提示，并保持CT-only推理流程。

Abstract: Accurate preoperative prediction of lung adenocarcinoma invasiveness is important for surgical planning and individualized treatment. However, overlapping CT appearances make it challenging to distinguish invasive adenocarcinoma (IAD) from Pre-IAD lesions. We propose a multimodal prompt-learning framework with dual-granularity image-text alignment for 3D CT-based IAD classification. A 3D ResNet-CBAM encoder extracts global and spatial visual features. A frozen RadBERT backbone is adapted with separate learnable prompts for report-level and keyword-level text encoding. These prompts are initialized using semantic representations derived from real-world clinical reports. Global contrastive alignment connects whole-volume CT representations with reports generated from clinician-annotated radiological attributes to provide overall semantic supervision. A multiple instance learning-based local alignment module associates spatial CT features with vascular-focused radiological keywords, to capture local imaging characteristics potentially associated with tumor invasion. The framework jointly optimizes classification and alignment objectives, while inference requires only CT images. Experiments included 1,593 pathologically confirmed nodules. On the test set, the proposed method achieved an accuracy of 87.92%, F1-score of 87.78%, and AUC of 0.9499. Its AUC significantly exceeded that of the image-only Res-CBAM baseline with the same visual backbone (0.9297; DeLong test, p = 0.0078). Ablation analyses supported the complementary contributions of global and local alignment and the benefit of report-based prompt initialization. Qualitative visualizations showed activation within nodules and adjacent vascular structures. These findings suggest that dual-granularity radiological supervision can enhance CT-based invasiveness prediction while preserving a CT-only inference workflow.

[227] SurgPace: Complexity-Aware Progressive Distillation for Surgical Multimodal Large Language Models cs.CVPDF

Zhicheng He, Xiaohan Xing, Hongqiu Wang, Kun Yuan, Guankun Wang

TL;DR: 论文提出SurgPace，一种面向手术多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的复杂度感知连续课程渐进蒸馏框架。它利用预测置信度和Lorentz几何一致性估计样本复杂度，引导由易到难的连续蒸馏训练，并通过特征、logit和概率层面的层次表示对齐，逐步从教师模仿转向任务监督。实验表明该方法能在Surg-396K上构建更紧凑、内存高效且解码更快的手术MLLM。

Details

Motivation: 手术MLLM计算成本高，限制临床部署；而直接知识蒸馏不适合手术数据，因为样本在难度、视觉模糊性和所需临床上下文上差异很大，统一教师-学生迁移不稳定，且训练不同阶段对教师监督和任务监督的依赖会变化。

Result: 在基于四个公开手术数据集构建、覆盖五种对话范式的Surg-396K基准上，SurgPace一致优于强MLLM蒸馏基线，证明其能构建紧凑、内存高效且解码更快的手术MLLM；摘要未给出具体定量数值或明确SOTA表述。

Insight: 主要创新是复杂度感知的连续课程蒸馏，将预测置信度与Lorentz几何一致性融合用于样本难度估计，并引入特征、logit、概率三级层次表示对齐。其可借鉴之处在于分离样本级课程与目标级调度，动态平衡教师模仿和任务监督，提升异构手术数据蒸馏的稳定性。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown strong potential in robotic surgery for question answering, scene understanding, and grounded assistance, but their high computational cost limits real clinical deployment. Knowledge distillation provides a practical way to build compact surgical MLLMs, yet direct distillation is not well suited to surgical data because surgical samples vary greatly in difficulty, visual ambiguity, and required clinical context, making uniform teacher-student transfer unstable. In addition, the role of supervision changes during training: early stages require stronger teacher guidance for multimodal alignment, while later stages rely more on task supervision for effective optimization. To address these challenges, we propose SurgPace, a complexity-aware continuous curriculum framework for progressive distillation of surgical vision-language models. SurgPace estimates sample complexity using predictive confidence and Lorentz geometric consistency, and uses the fused score to guide a continuous easy-to-hard training process. We further introduce hierarchical representation alignment, which aligns the student with the teacher at the feature, logit, and probability levels, while gradually shifting the training focus from teacher imitation to task supervision. This design separates sample-level curriculum from objective-level scheduling, leading to more stable and effective distillation. We evaluate SurgPace on Surg-396K, a benchmark built from four public surgical datasets and covering five dialogue paradigms. SurgPace consistently outperforms strong MLLM distillation baselines, demonstrating its effectiveness for building compact, memory-efficient surgical MLLMs with faster decoding under controlled benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/hezhicheng2002/SurgPace.

Junxi Huang, Wenshuo Chen, Xiucheng Wang, Meitong Shen, Shaofeng Liang

TL;DR: 论文提出行为亲和力传导（BAT），利用无标注查询批次中每张图像对类别词表的响应分布构建稀疏近邻图，在冻结视觉语言模型预测时引入邻居证据，并可结合 EM-Dirichlet 进行候选类筛选与分配初始化，从而提升零样本视觉-语言分类性能。

Details

Motivation: 现有零样本视觉语言模型对图像独立打分，未利用同一无标注批次中可能存在的有用邻居；而仅依赖视觉相似度又可能受姿态、背景等因素干扰，导致不同类别图像被错误连接。

Abstract: An image that is hard to classify on its own may have a helpful neighbor in the same unlabeled batch. Zero-shot vision-language models (VLMs) score images independently and leave this evidence unused. We study small unlabeled query batches with no labeled examples. Visual similarity can reflect pose or background, so it may connect images from different classes. Each image’s scores over the class vocabulary offer another way to choose neighbors. We introduce Behavioral Affinity Transduction (BAT), which builds a sparse graph from these class-response profiles. The graph supplies neighbor evidence during prediction. For EM-Dirichlet, it also screens candidate classes and initializes assignments. BAT plugs into direct and iterative readouts of a frozen VLM. Across diverse datasets, BAT improves the mean accuracy of every tested readout. In the main RN50 comparison, soft and hard EM-Dirichlet gain $4.22$ and $2.72$ percentage points.

Petr Surovtsev, Pavel Korotaev, Alexander Nagaev, Alexander Kapitanov

Details

Motivation: 俄语手语有超过 15 万名母语使用者，但此前缺乏公开的俄语手语手指拼写数据集，而美国、英国、德国等手语已有相关资源。论文旨在填补这一空白，为俄语手语手指拼写识别研究提供开放数据与参考基线。

Result: 数据集包含 37,252 段视频、35.4 小时、1,593 个唯一序列，覆盖 33 个西里尔字母手形。两个基线中，基于 Squeezeformer 的编码器-解码器达到字符级准确率 0.932、序列准确率 0.596；Fingerspelling-PoseNet 分别达到 0.886 和 0.545。

Insight: 主要创新在于构建首个公开的俄语手语手指拼写数据集，并采用众包采集、两阶段手语者资格筛选和专家验证来保证数据质量；同时提供可复现的基线，为后续俄语手语手指拼写识别研究建立参考。客观来看，其贡献更偏向数据资源与基准建设，方法本身主要借鉴美国手语手指拼写识别模型。

Abstract: Fingerspelling - the sequential signing of letters that compose proper names, technical terms, and out-of-vocabulary words - is an integral component of any sign language. Despite Russian Sign Language (RSL) being used by more than 150,000 native signers, no public fingerspelling dataset for RSL exists, in contrast to American, British, German, and several other sign languages. We introduce Znaki the first open RSL fingerspelling dataset: 37,252 video recordings (35.4 hours) of 1,593 unique sequences - proper names sampled from 16 domain categories - recorded by 68 native RSL signers (37 Deaf, 29 hard-of-hearing, and 2 certified interpreters) through a crowdsourcing pipeline with a two-stage signer qualification procedure and expert validation. The dataset covers all 33 Cyrillic handshapes, and its letter-frequency distribution matches the Russian National Corpus. As reference points for future research, we establish two baselines adapted from American Sign Language fingerspelling recognition: a Squeezeformer-based encoder-decoder, reaching a character-level accuracy ($1-\mathrm{CER}$) of 0.932 and a sequence accuracy of 0.596, and Fingerspelling-PoseNet, reaching 0.886 and 0.545, respectively.

Muhammad Ahmed Ullah Khan, Khalil Ahmed, Didier Stricker, Muhammad Zeshan Afzal

TL;DR: 论文首次对户外类增量3D目标检测进行跨自动驾驶基准的统一分析，覆盖KITTI和nuScenes上的两任务与多阶段增量设置，系统研究旧类遗忘、稳定性-可塑性困境及有效监督形式。作者提出CL3DOD框架，通过上一阶段检测器预测恢复旧类监督、query-wise知识蒸馏和EMA时序一致性正则来平衡旧知识保留与新类学习。

Details

Motivation: 户外类增量3D目标检测研究仍不充分，现有工作多局限于单一基准和不同增量设置，难以判断持续学习行为是否能跨自动驾驶基准泛化。论文旨在统一分析遗忘严重性和稳定性-可塑性困境，并寻找更有效的监督方式来平衡旧类保持与新类获取。

Result: 在KITTI和nuScenes上的两任务和多阶段实验均显示存在一致的稳定性-可塑性困境。CL3DOD通常比受控增量基线取得更优的稳定性-可塑性平衡，并在报告基准比较中优于已发表先前方法，且优势可延续到多个增量阶段，表现出较强的旧知识保留和新类学习能力。

Insight: 论文宣称的创新点包括首个跨多个自动驾驶基准的户外类增量3D检测统一分析，以及CL3DOD中利用上一阶段预测恢复旧类监督、query-wise知识蒸馏和EMA时序一致性正则的组合。客观来看，其价值在于统一评估揭示稳定性-可塑性困境，并针对旧类监督缺失设计互补的蒸馏与一致性约束。

Abstract: Class-incremental learning (CIL) for outdoor 3D object detection remains largely underexplored. Existing outdoor studies are limited to single-benchmark evaluations, with SDCoT++ considering KITTI and CL2OD considering nuScenes under different incremental settings. This makes it difficult to assess whether observed continual-learning behavior generalizes across autonomous-driving benchmarks. To the best of our knowledge, we provide the first unified cross-benchmark analysis of outdoor class-incremental 3D object detection across multiple autonomous-driving benchmarks, covering both two-task and multi-stage settings. We investigate: (1) how severely existing 3D detectors forget previously learned classes, (2) how incremental training exposes the stability-plasticity dilemma between knowledge retention and new-class acquisition, and (3) which forms of supervision are most effective for balancing these objectives. We introduce CL3DOD, a class-incremental 3D detection framework that restores missing supervision for previous classes using predictions from the previous-stage detector, preserves old-class responses through query-wise knowledge distillation, and employs EMA-based temporal consistency regularization. Experiments on KITTI and nuScenes reveal a consistent stability-plasticity dilemma across both benchmarks. CL3DOD generally achieves a more favorable stability-plasticity balance than controlled incremental baselines and improves upon published prior methods in the reported benchmark comparisons. This advantage persists across multiple incremental stages, demonstrating strong retention of previously learned knowledge while maintaining effective new-class acquisition. Our code, evaluation setup, and incremental task splits will be publicly released.

[231] Calibrating Multimodal Test-Time Adaptation under Reliability and Availability Modality Shifts cs.CVPDF

Jiangmeng Li, Jinglin Xu, Yi Li, Yumeng Liu, Jiahuan Zhou

TL;DR: 论文提出自适应概率高斯校准（AdaPGC）方法，用于多模态测试时适应场景下的分布偏移问题。该方法将类别条件高斯建模扩展到模态特定表示和融合表示，通过持续更新高斯模型进行概率校准，以应对模态可靠性偏移（信息质量下降但模态可用）和模态可用性偏移（模态完全缺失）两种情况，并利用联合分布恢复不可用的融合表示。

Details

Motivation: 多模态测试时适应比单模态更复杂，因为多种表示视角共存且交互，尤其在模态可靠性偏移和可用性偏移下。现有单模态TTA中有效的类别条件高斯建模难以直接扩展到多模态，需要更精细的公式化设计。

Result: 在多种模态损坏和缺失条件下的大量实验表明，AdaPGC能有效提升模型在模态可靠性和可用性偏移下的鲁棒性。摘要未提及具体基准或数值结果。

Insight: 创新点在于将类别条件高斯建模系统性地扩展到多模态TTA，覆盖模态特定表示和融合表示，并利用概率预测校准源模型、指导基于可靠性的校正，以及通过联合分布恢复不可用的融合表示。

Abstract: Multimodal test-time adaptation (TTA) enables pretrained multimodal models to accommodate distribution shifts during inference using only unlabeled test data, without recourse to the original training data. Compared with unimodal adaptation, multimodal adaptation is further complicated by the coexistence and interaction of multiple representation perspectives. This complexity is particularly pronounced under modality reliability shifts, which preserve modality availability but degrade information quality, and modality availability shifts, which render the corresponding modality entirely inaccessible. Category-conditional Gaussian modeling offers a natural starting point for handling such distributional variations, having proven effective in unimodal test-time adaptation for characterizing representation distributions, yet its extension to multimodal settings requires a more elaborate formulation. To this end, we propose Adaptive Probabilistic Gaussian Calibration (AdaPGC), which extends category-conditional Gaussian modeling across modality-specific and multimodal fusion representations for probabilistic calibration under multimodal distribution shifts. AdaPGC continuously updates category-conditional Gaussian models over modality-specific and fusion representations, using the resulting probabilistic predictions to calibrate source model predictions and guide reliability based rectification, while exploiting their joint distributions to recover unavailable fusion representations. Extensive experiments under diverse modality corruption and missingness conditions demonstrate that AdaPGC effectively improves robustness under both modality reliability and availability shifts. Our source code will be released at https://github.com/XuJinglinn/AdaPGC-plus.

[232] R$^2$-Omni: Reducing Structural and Precision Redundancy in Omni-LLMs for Long-Form Generation cs.CVPDF

Bolong Feng, Pengfei Zhou, Zhenglin Wan, Wei Wang, Wangbo Zhao

TL;DR: 论文针对Omni-LLM处理音视频多模态输入时KV cache内存和计算开销大的问题，指出激进token剪枝在多选题上有效但会损害长文本开放式生成质量。作者提出免训练框架R$^2$-Omni，联合减少token表示中的结构冗余和精度冗余：STC利用视频时空相似性和音频局部连续性合并冗余表示，SSPA按量化键下注意力输出误差估计为保留表示分配数值精度。

Details

Motivation: Omni-LLM处理大量音视频token导致高昂计算和KV cache内存开销；现有query-guided token剪枝虽能保留多选题所需证据，却丢弃长文本生成所需细节，因此需要在保留多样内容的同时减少token间重叠信息及缓存数值精度冗余。

Result: 在长文本生成基准上，R$^2$-Omni平均降低5.0倍内存占用，保持97.98%的基线生成质量，并实现1.48倍端到端加速，表明联合降低结构冗余和精度冗余有效。

Insight: 创新点在于提出免训练的R$^2$-Omni框架，从结构和精度两个层面压缩Omni-LLM的token表示：STC利用音视频模态先验合并冗余表示，SSPA根据注意力输出误差和语义先验分配缓存值精度。客观来看，其价值在于针对长文本生成场景重新审视token剪枝，并将KV cache压缩从单一结构维度拓展到结构-精度联合优化。

Abstract: Omni-modal large language models (Omni-LLMs) typically process large numbers of multimodal tokens from audio-visual inputs, incurring substantial computational costs and a large memory footprint for the key-value (KV) cache. Aggressive token pruning can alleviate this problem while maintaining competitive performance on multiple-choice tasks, which require only a single option as output. However, we observe substantial quality degradation when generating long-form, open-ended responses. We attribute this gap to query-guided selection, which can retain sufficient evidence for answer selection while discarding details needed for comprehensive generation. This motivates reducing overlapping information across tokens, termed structural redundancy, while preserving diverse content. However, the retained representations may still contain precision redundancy due to unnecessarily high numerical precision in their cached values. To address these two levels of redundancy in token representations, we introduce a training-free framework named R$^2$-Omni. First, Structure-Aware Token Consolidation (STC) consolidates redundant representations using spatiotemporal similarity in video and local continuity in audio. Then, Semantic-Sensitivity Guided Precision Allocation (SSPA) allocates value precision to the retained representations according to the estimated reduction in attention-output error under quantized keys, with query attention and audio-visual alignment providing a semantic prior. Extensive experiments on long-form generation benchmarks demonstrate an average 5.0$\times$ reduction in the memory footprint while preserving 97.98% of baseline generation quality and achieving a 1.48$\times$ end-to-end speedup, highlighting the benefits of jointly reducing structural and precision redundancy.

[233] ReVA-HPE: Relative 6DoF Head Pose Estimation with Synthetic Pose Supervision and Personalized Virtual Anchors cs.CVPDF

Vasiliki Vasileiou, Panagiotis P. Filntisis, Petros Maragos, Kostas Daniilidis

TL;DR: 论文提出 ReVA-HPE，将单目头部姿态估计从绝对回归和传统相对估计推进到完整 6DoF 相对估计：预测深度归一化的相对平移，并与 anchor 组合恢复查询图像在相机坐标系下的 metric 姿态。为摆脱推理时对 anchor 真实姿态的依赖，方法从单张未标注 enrollment 图像重建个性化 avatar，渲染已知姿态的虚拟 anchor bank，并通过多 anchor 共识获得鲁棒旋转假设；平移分支则用真实 enrollment 图像和 landmark PnP。论文还提出高效变体，在 enrollment 时一次性摊销虚拟 anchor bank 成本，后续查询只需一次 real-to-real 相对预测。

Details

Motivation: 现有相对头部姿态估计仍需在推理时已知 anchor 图像的真实姿态，限制了实际应用；同时，单张 face crop 的绝对回归难以利用同一人随时间观察可提供的 anchor 信息。论文希望消除对 ground-truth anchor pose 的依赖，并将相对估计扩展到完整 6DoF metric 查询姿态恢复。

Result: 在真实 6DoF benchmark 上，ReVA-HPE 在 BIWI 上取得 state-of-the-art 旋转精度，在给定近正面 enrollment 图像的 FaMoS 上也达到 SOTA；metric translation 具有竞争力。值得注意的是，相对姿态估计器仅用合成人脸渲染训练，不使用真实姿态监督、伪标签、域适应或评测集微调。

Insight: 创新点包括：将相对头部姿态估计扩展到完整 6DoF，并引入深度归一化相对平移；利用单张未标注 enrollment 图像重建个性化 avatar，生成已知姿态的虚拟 anchor bank，通过多 anchor 共识避免真实 anchor pose 标注；平移分支结合真实 enrollment 图像与 landmark PnP；以及 enrollment 时摊销虚拟 anchor 成本的高效变体。客观来看，其核心创新在于将个性化虚拟 anchor 与相对 6DoF 估计结合，并以纯合成姿态监督实现真实 benchmark 上的强性能。

Abstract: Monocular head pose estimation is usually formulated as absolute regression from a single face crop, yet many applications observe the same person over time and can supply an explicit anchor image. Recently, relative head pose estimation was proposed, which casts the problem as estimation of the relative geometric change between an anchor and a query image. However, existing methods still require the anchor image pose to be known at inference, significantly limiting their practical use. We first extend relative head pose estimation to full 6DoF by additionally predicting a depth-normalized relative translation, which composes with the anchor to recover metric query pose in the camera frame. To eliminate the need for a ground-truth anchor pose, we reconstruct a personalized avatar from a single unlabeled enrollment image and render a bank of virtual anchors with known poses. The bank provides robust rotation hypotheses through multi-anchor consensus, while the real enrollment image serves as the real anchor in the translation branch via landmark PnP. We also introduce an efficient variant that amortizes the bank cost once at enrollment, after which each query requires a single real-to-real relative prediction, with limited accuracy sacrifice. The relative pose estimator is trained exclusively on synthetic face renderings, without real pose supervision, pseudo-labels, domain adaptation, or fine-tuning on the evaluation sets. On real 6DoF benchmarks, ReVA-HPE achieves state-of-the-art rotation accuracy on BIWI and, given a near-frontal enrollment image, on FaMoS, while remaining competitive in metric translation despite relying solely on synthetic pose supervision. Project page and code: https://vasilikivas.github.io/ReVA-HPE/

[234] ArabGeoText: Tool-Augmented Vision-Language Models for Arabic Geospatial Text Spotting cs.CVPDF

Yakoub Bazi, Sarah Alsaleh, Mohamad M. Al Rahhal, Mohamed A. Mekhtiche, Mansour Zuair

TL;DR: 论文构建了面向阿拉伯语地理空间文本的 ARABGEOTEXT 基准，包含利雅得和吉达 970 个地点，每类视图 17,875 个人工标注文本实例，并提供 OSM 渲染与遥感影像叠加的成对视图及城市内/跨城市评测划分。针对直接使用 Qwen3.5-4B 难以恢复图块内全部标签的问题，提出工具增强视觉语言框架：YOLO26 定位与裁剪矫正，结合 LoRA 适配的 Qwen3.5-4B 识别。

Motivation: 阿拉伯语地理空间文本定位与转录在栅格地图中尚未充分研究，标签通常小、密集且方向任意，直接 VLM 识别困难。论文旨在建立基准并提升复杂地图背景下的检测、识别与端到端定位性能。

Result: 实验表明该工具增强框架在两种图像视图和测试城市上均优于直接 LoRA 适配的 Qwen3.5-4B spotting；在固定定位结果时，识别器适配相较预训练零样本识别器进一步提升识别效果。摘要未给出具体数值。

Insight: 创新点在于构建成对 OSM/遥感视图且保持标签内容与像素几何一致的阿拉伯语地理空间文本基准，并设计定位、矫正、识别解耦的工具增强 VLM 流程。客观看，其价值在于诊断现有 VLM 短板、提供跨背景和跨城市评测，以及用模块化工具链弥补端到端模型能力不足。

Abstract: Geospatial text spotting involves locating and transcribing geographic labels, such as road names, district names, and landmarks, in raster maps. These labels are often small, densely arranged, and arbitrarily oriented. Although Arabic text recognition has been studied extensively in documents and natural scenes, Arabic geospatial text spotting remains underexplored. We introduce ARABGEOTEXT, an Arabic-centric benchmark covering 970 geographic locations in Riyadh and Jeddah, with 17,875 manually annotated text instances per view type. For each location, we pair an OpenStreetMap (OSM) rendering with a composite created by overlaying that rendering on the corresponding remote sensing (RS) imagery. The paired views preserve label content and pixel geometry, allowing evaluation across different backgrounds. Geographic partitions support in-city and city-disjoint evaluation of detection, recognition, and end-to-end spotting. Experiments with direct Qwen3.5-4B spotting show difficulties in recovering all labels within a tile. We therefore propose a tool-augmented vision-language framework that combines YOLO26 localization and crop rectification with Qwen3.5-4B recognition adapted through low-rank adaptation (LoRA). The framework outperforms direct LoRA-adapted Qwen3.5-4B spotting across both image views and test cities. With localization held fixed, reader adaptation further improves recognition over the pretrained zero-shot reader. Moein Heidari, Junbo Rao, Yudan Chen, Yasamin Medghalchi, River Jiang

TL;DR: 论文提出Kev-Bio，一种视觉语言模型，利用临床测量问题引导超声标志点检测。受System One决策模型启发，模型用语言模型的决策表示生成每个卡尺端点的查询，并与共享的密集超声特征匹配，生成空间概率图，从中导出标志点坐标和临床测量。模型以标志点定位损失和临床测量损失端到端训练。

Details

Motivation: 超声生物测量依赖手动放置卡尺，存在操作者间差异；传统方法针对不同任务使用专用预测头，而视觉语言模型虽可通过文本指令提供灵活性，但直接坐标预测未显式建模空间似然分布，难以表示定位歧义。

Result: 在九视图FU/GU Biometry 2026数据集上，Kev-Bio取得平均径向误差（MRE）22.50像素和临床测量平均绝对误差（MAE）15.38，总体性能优于对比基线。

Insight: 创新点在于用语言模型决策表示生成卡尺端点查询，并与共享密集超声特征匹配以产生空间概率图，从而显式建模定位不确定性和空间似然；同时以临床测量问题统一引导多视图超声标志点检测与测量，并端到端联合优化定位和测量损失。

Abstract: Purpose: Ultrasound biometry is widely used across various clinical applications, including prenatal and cardiac examinations, to obtain quantitative measurements by placing calipers at anatomical landmarks. However, these measurements remain subject to interoperator variability as they rely largely on manual caliper placement. Conventional methods often use specialized prediction heads for different ultrasound tasks, whereas vision-language models offer flexibility through text instructions. However, direct coordinate prediction does not explicitly model spatial likelihood distributions, limiting the representation of localization ambiguity. Methods: We propose Kev-Bio, a vision-language model that uses clinical measurement questions to guide ultrasound landmark detection. Inspired by System One decision models, Kev-Bio uses decision representations of the language model to generate queries for each caliper endpoint. These queries are matched against shared dense ultrasound features to produce spatial probability maps, from which landmark coordinates and clinical measurements are derived. The model is trained end-to-end using both landmark localization and clinical measurement losses. Results: On the nine-view FU/GU Biometry 2026 dataset, Kev-Bio achieves a mean radial error (MRE) of 22.50 pixels and a clinical measurement mean absolute error (MAE) of 15.38, outperforming the compared baselines in overall performance. Conclusion: These results demonstrate the effectiveness of Kev-Bio for ultrasound landmark detection and clinical measurement across different anatomical views. Our code and models are available at https://github.com/moeinheidari7829/Kev-Bio.

[236] Fuse To Align: Multimodal Representation Learning for Retrieval via Hypergraph Regularization cs.CVPDF

Anindya Nag, Ambuj Mehrish, Sebastiano Vascon

TL;DR: 论文提出一种训练时超图融合框架，用于多模态检索中的表示学习。该方法通过超图连接样本内观测模态与语义相关样本间的模态，使表示学习能利用单样本之外的信息，同时推理阶段保持原检索流程不变。框架将HyVol作为特例，并给出wHyVol和wRHG两种配置。实验在零样本视频-文本和音频-文本检索任务上验证了有效性。

Details

Motivation: 多模态检索需要整合可能缺失、噪声大或信息量不等的多视角证据；仅从单样本视角学习难以获得有效检索表示。现有基于volume的目标通常在样本内联合对齐模态，未显式支持语义相关样本间的信息交换。

Result: 在11个零样本视频-文本和音频-文本检索benchmark上，GRAM和HyperGRAM均取得广泛提升。17个视频benchmark-modality设置的双向检索中，wRHG在34项比较中全部优于GRAM，并在33/34项优于HyperGRAM；平均文本到视频R@1由63.4提升至68.2（GRAM）和64.8提升至68.4（HyperGRAM），ActivityNet上视频到文本最大提升13.3个百分点。缺失模态评估中，在7个benchmark的各缺失率下均保持正向增益，即使90%片段缺失一种模态。

Insight: 创新点在于用超图在训练时同时建模样本内和跨语义相关样本的模态连接，并以正则化方式增强多模态对齐；缺失模态直接省略而非插补，训练后丢弃超图，因而不增加推理成本。客观看，其可借鉴之处是将跨样本语义关系引入多模态表示学习，并通过wRHG的关系传播建模类型交互与参与者角色。

Abstract: Multimodal retrieval must integrate complementary evidence from views that may be missing, noisy, or unequally informative. When a sample provides limited reliable evidence, learning from its views alone can hinder the acquisition of useful retrieval representations. Semantically related training samples may provide complementary observations, yet existing volume-based objectives jointly align modalities within each sample without explicitly enabling information exchange across samples. We therefore propose a training-time hypergraph fusion framework that connects observed modalities both within samples and across semantically related samples, allowing representation learning to draw on evidence beyond an individual sample while leaving the retrieval pipeline unchanged at inference. The framework includes HyVol as a special case and introduces two configurations: wHyVol learns view contribution weights and symmetric semantic affinities, whereas wRHG additionally models typed interactions and participant roles through relational propagation. Missing modalities are omitted rather than imputed, and the hypergraph is discarded after training, incurring no additional inference cost. Experiments on eleven zero-shot video-text and audio-text retrieval benchmarks demonstrate broad improvements with both GRAM and HyperGRAM. Across 17 video benchmark-modality settings evaluated in both retrieval directions, wRHG outperforms GRAM in all 34 comparisons and HyperGRAM in 33 of 34. Mean text-to-video R@1 increases from 63.4 to 68.2 with GRAM and from 64.8 to 68.4 with HyperGRAM, while the largest video-to-text gain reaches 13.3 percentage points on ActivityNet. Under missing-modality evaluation, both weighted configurations retain positive text-to-video gains over GRAM across seven benchmarks at every evaluated missingness rate, even when 90% of clips lack one modality.

[237] EO-Jev: Decision Model for Earth Observation cs.CVPDF

Mohamed Atef Abouelhadid, Diaa Addeen Abuhani, Muhammad Akhtar Munir, Fahad Shahbaz Khan, Salman Khan

TL;DR: 论文研究面向地球观测（EO）的决策模型，先对8.4B参数的d3-flash在23个公开EO基准的30个设置上进行诊断分析，发现组合推理迁移较好、校准优于Qwen3.5-9B骨干，但在计数、变化量化、损毁分级和缺失目标识别上仍具挑战；随后通过低秩微调公开EO训练集得到EO-Jev，使其成为有竞争力的EO通用模型。

Details

Motivation: EO工作流需要在已知结果中选择答案、估计置信度并处理大量影像；生成式视觉语言模型自回归解码计算昂贵且置信度不可靠，而决策模型可单次前向输出候选答案概率，但其在EO任务上的准确性、校准和跨任务迁移尚不清楚。

Result: 诊断发现d3-flash在24个设置上校准优于Qwen3.5-9B骨干；EO-Jev在30个设置中的26个上显著优于d3-flash，在28个中的20个上匹配或超过专家参考，12个留出设置平均提升8.0分，并在28个中的21个上具有更低期望校准误差，代价是通用决策性能小幅下降1.8分。

Insight: 创新点在于系统诊断通用决策模型在多样EO任务上的能力与缺陷，并用低秩微调将其适配为有竞争力的EO通用决策模型；客观看，贡献更偏向诊断分析、轻量适配与校准评估，定量感知、选项顺序一致性和分布偏移下校准仍是待解决问题。

Abstract: Earth observation (EO) workflows require selecting among known outcomes, estimating confidence, and processing large volumes of imagery. Generative vision-language models can address these tasks, but autoregressive decoding is computationally costly and their confidence estimates are unreliable. Decision models offer an alternative, returning probabilities over candidate answers in a single forward pass. However, their accuracy, calibration, and transfer across EO tasks remain insufficiently understood. We investigate these properties through a diagnostic study of d3-flash (8.4B parameters) across 30 settings from 23 public EO benchmarks. We find that compositional reasoning transfers well and calibration improves over its Qwen3.5-9B backbone on 24 settings, while counting, change quantification, damage grading, and absent-object recognition remain challenging. To address these limitations, we adapt d3-flash through low-rank fine-tuning on public EO training splits, producing EO-Jev. EO-Jev improves significantly over d3-flash on 26 of 30 settings and matches or exceeds specialist references on 20 of 28. It also achieves an average gain of 8.0 points across 12 held-out settings and lower expected calibration error than specialists on 21 of 28 settings. These improvements come at a modest cost of 1.8 points in general decision performance. Our results demonstrate the potential of adapting general decision models into competitive EO generalists while highlighting persistent challenges in quantitative perception, option-order consistency, and calibration under distribution shift.

[238] ASCoR: Asymmetric Semantic-Spatial Learning for Remote Sensing Domain Generalization cs.CVPDF

Zitong Wang, Shuchang Lyu, Meng Li, Qiang Wang, Guangliang Cheng

TL;DR: 论文提出ASCoR，一种基于SAM3的非对称语义-空间遥感域泛化语义分割框架。该方法结合文本条件语义分支、Probe-Once动态自适应LoRA、冻结图像编码器的任务特定密集分支以及可靠性路由器，在仅使用源域监督训练的条件下提升未见域分割性能，并在多个遥感跨域基准上取得领先结果。

Details

Motivation: 遥感语义分割在无目标域数据的源域泛化场景下需要可靠预测；现有视觉基础模型虽具迁移性，但类别识别易受源域特定视觉线索影响，而任务特定适配可能削弱预训练模型的可迁移性。

Result: 在ISPRS、LoveDA和OpenEarthMap共九个跨域迁移上评估，ASCoR在六个ISPRS迁移上取得68.61%平均mIoU，较此前最佳方法提升2.69个百分点；在三个LoveDA/OpenEarthMap迁移上均获最佳，mIoU分别为59.07%、47.95%和49.38%。

Insight: 创新点在于非对称语义-空间双分支设计：用类名提示提供显式类别引导，以固定预算的动态自适应LoRA限制源域特化，并通过冻结图像编码器保留空间表示，最后由轻量可靠性路由器进行有界空间校正。客观上看，其核心价值是将语义先验、参数高效适配与可靠性驱动融合结合，以缓解域泛化中的源域过拟合和迁移性退化问题。

Abstract: Source-only domain generalization (DG) for remote sensing semantic segmentation seeks reliable predictions in unseen domains without target-domain data during training. Although vision foundation models offer transferable knowledge, category recognition remains sensitive to source-specific visual cues, while task-specific adaptation may weaken pretrained transferability. We propose ASCoR, an asymmetric semantic-spatial framework built on SAM3. Its text-conditioned semantic branch uses class-name prompts to provide explicit category guidance. Probe-Once Dynamic Adaptive LoRA distributes a fixed adaptation budget across encoder blocks to limit source-specific specialization. A complementary task-specific dense branch learns multi-scale spatial representations using a separate frozen SAM3 image encoder. A lightweight reliability router integrates the two branches through bounded spatial correction based on local prediction reliability. All components are trained using source-domain supervision only. Experiments on the ISPRS, LoveDA, and OpenEarthMap benchmarks cover nine cross-domain transfers. ASCoR achieves a state-of-the-art mean IoU of 68.61% across six ISPRS transfers, outperforming the previous best method by 2.69 percentage points. It also achieves the best results on all three LoveDA/OpenEarthMap transfers, with 59.07%, 47.95%, and 49.38% mIoU on Rural-to-Urban, Urban-to-Rural, and Urban-to-OpenEarthMap, respectively. Ablation studies, feature visualizations, and spatial reliability analyses support the effectiveness and complementarity of the proposed components. Code: https://github.com/WangZitong42/ASCoR.

[239] TaoMate-FVSR:Audio-Guided Facial Video Restoration cs.CVPDF

Xinyang Li, Zeran Xu, Qijun Gan, Chenwei Zhang, Meiguang Jin

TL;DR: 论文提出 TaoMate-FVSR，一种音频引导的面部视频恢复框架，基于参考引导的视频流模型，结合源-噪声混合初始化与结构化参考注入，从低分辨率 AI 生成视频中恢复面部细节，并在音频替换时保持唇齿与语音同步。训练同时包含退化图像/视频恢复和目标音频下的退化配音源校正，以兼顾视觉质量与音画同步。

Details

Motivation: AI 生成视频中人物面部区域分辨率低，传统超分辨率只能提升清晰度，无法判断恢复的嘴唇和牙齿是否与语音一致；论文旨在解决面部细节恢复与音频同步之间的歧义。

Result: 在 talking-head 恢复基准上，该方法在成对感知相似度和同步分数上优于所比较的恢复方法；组件实验验证了音频条件、重建形式和参考注入的作用，AIGC 样例展示了对唇轮廓、牙齿结构和面部纹理的恢复。

Insight: 创新点在于将音频引导引入参考引导视频流恢复，通过源-噪声混合初始化保留部分观测信息，并用结构化参考注入分离外观锚点与连续运动上下文；同时联合恢复训练与目标音频下的配音校正监督，使模型在恢复细节的同时支持视觉配音。

Abstract: AI-generated videos often depict people within detailed scenes while leaving their small facial regions poorly resolved. Visual super-resolution can sharpen these regions without resolving whether the recovered lips and teeth agree with the spoken audio. We present an audio-guided facial video restoration framework that addresses this ambiguity within a reference-guided video flow model. Source–noise mixing initializes reconstruction from a partially preserved observation, and structured reference injection separates appearance anchors from continuous motion context. Training combines restoration of degraded images and videos with correction of degraded dubbed sources under target audio. Appearance and synchronization supervision allow the model to recover facial detail and support visual dubbing when the audio is replaced. On talking-head restoration benchmarks, our method achieves the best paired perceptual similarity and synchronization scores among the compared restoration methods. Component comparisons examine audio conditioning, the reconstruction formulation, and reference injection. Native AIGC examples further illustrate the recovery of lip contours, dental structure, and surrounding facial texture in scene-level footage. injection. Native AIGC examples further illustrate the recovery of lip contours, dental structure, and surrounding facial texture in scene-level footage.

[240] TaoMate-HD: Progressive-Resolution Autoregressive Audio-Video Generation cs.CVPDF

Qijun Gan, Chenwei Zhang, Xinyang Li, Meiguang Jin, Junfeng Ma

TL;DR: 论文提出 TaoMate-HD，一个面向高分辨率音视频流式生成的自回归模型。它按短片段生成，每片段先用两步低分辨率去噪建立粗视频结构，再用一步精炼到高分辨率，并同步生成音频；各阶段将视听预测作为下一片段同阶段的历史，从而支持文本更新下的连续语音与小时级音视频生成。

Details

Motivation: 流式数字人需要边接收新文本边持续说话并生成细节视频，但高分辨率去噪成本高，文本更新还容易导致语音重复或中断。

Result: 实验显示，相比同模型同硬件直接高分辨率生成获得1.6倍加速；优化的阶段并行部署相比串行渐进生成再获得1.9倍整体加速；延续训练使字符错误率相对基线降低11.18个百分点，并支持小时级音视频生成。

Insight: 创新点在于渐进分辨率的分块自回归去噪、跨片段同阶段历史传递以保持跨文本更新的语音连续性，以及生成与蒸馏使用不同文本窗口的非对称文本条件延续训练。

Abstract: Streaming digital humans produce detailed video while continuing speech as new text arrives. High-resolution denoising is costly, and text updates can cause repeated or interrupted speech. We present TaoMate-HD, an autoregressive model for high-resolution audio-video streaming. For each short segment, or chunk, two denoising steps establish coarse video structure at low resolution. A final step refines the video to high resolution, with audio generated throughout the same trajectory. Each stage passes its audiovisual predictions to the same stage of the next chunk as history. Across text updates, the model retains this history to infer what has already been spoken. Continuation training utilizes asymmetric text conditioning, with separate text windows for generation and distillation. Experiments show a 1.6x speedup over direct high-resolution generation with the same model and hardware. Optimized stage-parallel deployment provides a further 1.9x overall speedup over serial progressive generation. Our continuation training reduces character error rate by 11.18 percentage points relative to the baseline. The model also supports hour-long audiovisual generation. Our project page is https://taoliveaigc.github.io/TaoMate-HD.

[241] VidDub: Replacement-Aware Distillation for Two-Step Video Dubbing cs.CVPDF

Yexin Liu, Yunlong Lin, Zehan Wang, Guangxin He, Xinli Xu

TL;DR: 论文面向视频配音任务，提出替换感知的跨音频监督：配对音频样本做全帧重建，替换音频样本屏蔽源嘴区域的重建损失，仅通过音视频同步监督嘴部，同时保留面部其他区域和背景。作者提出VidDub全上下文扩散编辑器，先训练替换感知教师模型获得准确唇同步，再通过匹配轨迹回归和分布匹配蒸馏压缩为两步去噪学生模型，并发布VidDub-Bench等评测资源。

Details

Motivation: 现有视频配音编辑器多在原始配对音频下做自重建训练，但当驱动语音被替换时，源视频中的嘴部会成为冲突的重建目标，导致唇形同步学习受干扰。论文旨在解决替换音频场景下源嘴重建目标与目标语音唇形同步之间的矛盾，同时保持说话人身份、头部姿态和背景。

Result: 在三个训练种子下，屏蔽冲突的源嘴重建使跨音频Sync-C提升0.833；最终两步模型在四个基准上结合了较强唇同步、更优视觉质量、身份保持和视觉语音识别表现。摘要未明确宣称总体SOTA。

Insight: 创新点在于识别源嘴重建与替换语音之间的目标冲突，并设计替换感知的跨音频掩码监督；同时利用离线配音可预先获得完整源视频和目标语音的特点，将全上下文扩散教师蒸馏为2 NFE学生，并用轨迹回归与分布匹配兼顾同步和视觉质量。

Abstract: Video dubbing aims to synthesize lip movements that match target speech while preserving the speaker identity, head pose, and background of a source video. Existing editors are predominantly trained via self-reconstruction under original paired audio, even though the source mouth becomes a conflicting target when driving speech is replaced. We introduce replacement-aware cross-audio supervision: paired-audio samples use full-frame reconstruction, whereas unpaired replacement-audio samples mask out source-mouth reconstruction losses and supervise the mouth solely through audio-visual synchronization while preserving unmasked facial regions and background. Because offline dubbing provides the complete source video and target speech beforehand, we present VidDub, a full-context diffusion editor distilled into two denoising steps (2 NFE). Our replacement-aware teacher first learns accurate lip synchronization without regressing toward conflicting source mouth movements. Matched trajectory regression then transfers the teacher’s CFG-guided trajectories to a two-step student, and distribution matching distillation recovers visual quality after step compression. We will release the curated training dataset, VidDub-Bench, fixed paired- and cross-audio evaluation manifests, preprocessing outputs, and unified evaluation code. Across three training seeds, masking out conflicting source-mouth reconstruction improves cross-audio Sync-C by 0.833; the final two-step model combines strong lip synchronization with superior visual quality, identity preservation, and visual speech recognition across four benchmarks.

Abstract: Autonomous mobility is essential for sustained lunar surface operations, as communication delays and line-of-sight occlusions limit continuous teleoperation. Instead, the choice of training source emerges as the dominant factor in transfer quality: models trained on domain-relevant sources transfer substantially better to real lunar imagery than the geometric fusion strategy improves any single model. Abstract: Foundational vision models have become the de facto standard for many vision tasks due to their strong performance. However, they are notoriously opaque and remain hard to interpret. ALOE is robust across pre-training paradigms (supervised, self-supervised, vision-language) and can preserve teacher-level generalization with orders of magnitude less data than training from scratch. On classification, it strongly outperforms vanilla B-cosification (e.g., +10.5 p.p. top-1 on ImageNet for DINOv3 ViT-B/16), retains strong linear probing, k-NN, and zero-shot transfer competitive with foundational backbones (DINOv3, SigLIP2) across diverse downstream datasets. Abstract: Text-to-CAD generation aims to make CAD modeling more accessible by generating executable CAD programs from natural-language descriptions. However, practical CAD workflows require more than executable geometry: generated programs should also expose reusable structure that supports later modification. We introduce intent-oriented text-to-CAD generation, where design intent is expressed as recoverable code-level signals: semantic features, reusable parameters, and lightweight parametric relations. Rather than changing the model architecture or decoding procedure, we investigate how supervision representation granularity affects both CAD generation and zero-shot intent-preserving editing. To enable this study, we construct IntentCAD-100K, a 100K paired text–code dataset built by converting low-level CAD construction traces into executable CadQuery programs. We further construct IntentCAD-Edit-1K to evaluate zero-shot intent-preserving editing from the same representation perspective. Intent2CAD uses a two-stage conservative lifting pipeline: semantic lifting rewrites reliable primitive groups into feature-level operations, while parametric lifting exposes lightweight parametric relations. Under controlled fine-tuning, semantic lifting mainly improves generation reliability and feature recovery, reducing IR from 2.39% to 0.22% and achieving 99.96% API Recovery, while parametric lifting makes reusable relation structure explicit and further improves relation-aware zero-shot editing. Abstract: Skin cancer diagnosis, particularly differentiating melanoma from benign nevi, is challenging due to the visual similarity between lesions. Although convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and vision transformers (ViTs) have shown promising performance, their effectiveness often deteriorates on data from heterogeneous clinical sources. Conventional domain adaptation methods address domain shift but require access to source data during adaptation, which is often infeasible due to privacy regulations. Multi-source-free unsupervised domain adaptation (MSFDA) addresses this limitation by leveraging multiple labeled source domains to generalize to an unlabeled target domain without requiring access to source data. However, existing MSFDA methods rely on full backbone fine-tuning, leading to catastrophic forgetting and overfitting on small clinical datasets, and address domain shift at the aggregation stage without establishing a shared domain-invariant feature space. Furthermore, their reliance on hard pseudo-labels or confidence-weighted aggregation introduces noisy supervision signals under domain shift. To address these limitations, we propose CAT-CKD, consisting of two components: (1) contrastive adapter training (CAT), which trains lightweight ConvPass adapters within a frozen ViT backbone using supervised contrastive learning (SCL) to establish a shared domain-invariant feature space before source-specific model training, and (2) consensus knowledge distillation (CKD), which aggregates logits from multiple source models into a consensus supervisory signal and adapts a student model on unlabeled target data using KL divergence. Experiments on five publicly available skin lesion datasets show that CAT-CKD achieves an average AUROC of 86.1%, outperforming existing MSFDA methods while requiring only 4.3M trainable parameters. The code is available at https://github.com/A-Abedi/CAT_CKD.

Abstract: Timely and accurate crop health diagnosis is essential for sustainable agricultural production, yet accurate diagnosis often requires expert knowledge that is not readily available. Recent vision-language models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in visual understanding, reasoning, and natural-language interaction, creating new opportunities for intelligent crop health assessment. However, deploying VLMs on resource-constrained devices remains challenging due to their substantial computational and memory requirements. This paper presents PlantVLM-Edge, a quantized vision-language framework for conversational crop health diagnosis that can run entirely on resource-constrained edge devices. PlantVLM-Edge combines agricultural domain adaptation, post-training quantization, and on-device serving with an offline chat interface, allowing growers to ask open-ended questions and receive diagnoses, symptom explanations, and management guidance without cloud connectivity. The framework is backbone-agnostic: we validate it with two different VLM types with varying scale and architecture (Qwen3-VL-2B and LLaVA-1.5-7B), four quantization schemes, and two diagnostic domains (plant diseases and insect pests), and we deploy all variants on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin. Eight-bit quantization affects answer quality minimally relative to the full-precision model, and 4-bit activation-aware weight quantization (AWQ) retains 98.6% of full-precision answer quality on both domains while reducing the weight memory of the 2B backbone by 49%. In its most compact form, PlantVLM-Edge requires 2.01 GiB of weight memory, returns its first token in about 0.12 s, and completes a 64-token diagnostic response in 0.78 s. These results demonstrate that timely and accurate crop health diagnosis is practical on edge devices, providing a foundation for next-generation crop monitoring and decision support systems.

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can generate detailed video captions, yet they may overemphasize minor details while overlooking essential context and key events. We argue that not all visual evidence deserves equal attention, as the importance of visual information depends on the content of each video. Motivated by this observation, we propose Reviso, an agentic video captioning framework that learns what to observe and how to gather relevant visual evidence. From a low-frame-rate global preview, Reviso constructs a hierarchical Context–Focus–Points (CFP) observation plan that identifies the video context, prioritizes key aspects, and defines concrete observation targets and corresponding tools. Guided by this plan, Reviso performs goal-directed active perception by selectively revisiting temporal segments and combining tools for fine-grained inspection. It interprets the acquired evidence, updates its plan as needed, and integrates global and local information to generate the final caption. To learn this observation strategy, we develop a verification-guided pipeline that constructs high-quality training trajectories through factual verification and teacher-guided refinement. We further train Reviso using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), incorporating a key-fact reward for caption quality, a Plan Alignment Reward (PAR) for identifying important observation targets, and an Unproductive Tool-Call Penalty (UTCP) that adjusts observation-cost penalties based on caption quality. Experiments across four video captioning benchmarks show that Reviso outperforms the evaluated open-source baselines, while its generated captions better support downstream video question answering. These findings highlight the effectiveness and potential of priority-guided active observation for video captioning.
