Abstract: We present Isekai3D Synthetic Data Generation (SDG), a platform for simulating and capturing synthetic 3D gameplay for research in vision and world models, neural graphics, gameplay agents, and other applications. The platform combines reusable environment and character assets with Unreal Engine plugins in a two-stage workflow. First, world simulation generates gameplay while recording the world state, character movements, actions, and camera tracks needed for replay. Second, the recorded simulation is replayed to capture selected outputs, such as rendered video, images, and depth maps, at a specified resolution and frame rate under selected rendering and camera configurations. Separating simulation from capture allows the same recorded gameplay to produce multiple output variants without repeating the original simulation. Visual outputs are accompanied by frame-aligned camera, character, and action metadata. The platform uploads generated data directly in a training-friendly format, reducing intermediate storage, preparation time, and manual processing. This report describes the design of our overall system, including the platform’s assets, plugins, and their functionality, explaining how they work together to generate diverse synthetic gameplay data.

Abstract: Learning from human data offers a scalable path toward embodied intelligence, yet it requires models to accurately understand fine-grained human actions from egocentric observations. However, existing benchmarks remain limited in action atomicity, temporal precision, and hand-action association. We introduce EgoActionBench, a benchmark that represents continuous human manipulation as temporally localized atomic actions associated with the left hand, right hand, or both hands. EgoActionBench contains 1,407 episodes with 41,132 human-refined action annotations. To evaluate such dense predictions, we propose an evaluation protocol that retrieves temporally eligible candidates, selects a prediction by content agreement, and scores semantic fidelity and temporal overlap alongside action precision and recall, jointly capturing what happens, when it happens, and which hand performs it. We benchmark 20 baseline models and systems on EgoActionBench and further adapt two backbones, Qwen3-VL-4B and LLaVA-OneVision-2-8B, through supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning on automatically annotated training episodes. EgoAction improves EgoActionScore by 15.9 and 23.2 points on the two backbones, and both adapted models outperform all open-source baselines. Our experiments reveal substantial limitations of current models in action atomicity, temporal precision, and hand-action association, highlighting the gap between general video understanding and the action understanding required for embodied intelligence.

Abstract: Simulated students offer a scalable way to test learning platforms and AI tutors before deployment with real students and to augment scarce data for studying learning at scale. Existing LLM-based simulators primarily target short, language-centered interactions. In open-ended learning environments, however, student behavior emerges from patterns across long-horizon interaction trajectories, where turn-level prompting can drift from an assigned behavior profile. We introduce ALPS (Align Long-term by Planning Short-term), a hierarchical simulated student conditioned on observable, environment-specific behavior profiles. Rather than selecting every action independently, ALPS alternates between planning profile-aligned task segments and generating the corresponding actions. We evaluate ALPS in both data-sufficient and data-scarce settings, where supervision comes either from real student trajectories or from a teacher LLM. Across both settings, we compare in-context learning (ICL), supervised fine-tuning (SFT), reward-ranked fine-tuning (RAFT), and their sequential combination (SFT followed by RAFT). Experiments in an inquiry-based physics game and a pharmacy simulation evaluate behavioral density and coverage against held-out real data, and profile consistency using a human-aligned LLM judge. Across both settings, ALPS consistently outperforms turn-level generation, achieving comparable density and judge pass rates under scarce supervision, although coverage remains lower. These results show that hierarchical planning enables faithful, profile-aligned simulation over long interaction horizons, even with limited real student data.

Abstract: Digital learning environments produce rich clickstream data that can reveal how students approach learning tasks, yet interpreting these fine-grained traces often requires substantial expert effort. Given a student clickstream and a predefined set of learning strategies, ClickSight uses a staged LLM-based pipeline to identify strategy-relevant evidence, assess adherence to each strategy, and generate an evidence-grounded interpretation of the student’s behavior. We evaluate ClickSight across two learning environments, 365 students, and 12 model backbones using an expert-grounded quality rubric and an LLM judge calibrated with human-expert ratings. Our results show that ClickSight can generate high-quality strategy-based interpretations across different models and environments, with reasoning models performing more consistently than instruction-tuned counterparts. We further find that providing external clickstream-extracted guidance can improve interpretation quality for strategies that require precise quantitative information from the trace. By connecting fine-grained clickstreams with theoretically defined learning strategies and preserving the evidence underlying each judgment, ClickSight provides a flexible approach for studying student behavior in digital learning environments.

Details

Motivation: 现有研究已知LLM可通过上下文学习进行表格数值预测，但尚不清楚变量名和上下文示例在何种条件下、以何种机制发挥作用，尤其缺乏对语义接地作用的系统分析。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance across diverse tasks, from question answering to code generation. Recent studies have found that LLMs can perform numerical prediction on tabular datasets via in-context learning. However, it remains unclear under what conditions and how LLMs use variable names and in-context examples for numerical prediction. Here we show that semantic grounding, the match between variable names and the values they describe, allows five LLMs without task-specific training to match or outperform seven supervised machine learning (ML) models across 20 datasets from nine scientific domains, particularly when examples are scarce. Reasoning traces indicate that variable names allow LLMs to draw on domain-specific knowledge acquired during pretraining. Using controlled tasks based on physical formulas, we further show that LLMs integrate domain-specific knowledge with in-context examples in a way consistent with Bayesian updating. Specifically, when the relationship between the inputs and the target cannot be inferred from the examples alone, LLMs rely on domain-specific knowledge as the prior. Conversely, as contradicting examples accumulate, LLM predictions shift progressively towards these examples, which act as the likelihood. Our work reveals how LLMs use domain-specific knowledge in numerical prediction and positions them as data-efficient predictors for data-scarce scientific domains.

Abstract: Recursively self-improving (RSI) systems are increasingly viewed as a promising means of accelerating progress toward artificial general intelligence. They aim to autonomously improve their capabilities by refining their working pipelines and recursively improving the strategies that guide subsequent refinements, with gains generalizing to unseen scenarios.However, existing evaluations lack reliable metrics to distinguish capability gains from scenario fitting, sustainable and extensible protocols for unseen tasks and difficulties, and fine-grained attribution of improvement to evolution traces. To this end, we propose SelfImprove-Bench,an RSI evaluation framework that organizes tasks into three primary capabilities (i.e., Exploring, Planning, Reasoning) as scenarios for guiding model evolution. We instantiated the tasks on games for controllability and reproducibility, and pairs them with scalable generation and orchestration driven by task templates and difficulty coefficients. Beyond task-level scores, SelfImprove-Bench organizes evaluation into generalization ladder levels G0 to G4 that measure how far gains transfer from training conditions. Experiments reveal that the evolutionary gains of existing RSI methods are inconsistent across generalization levels.

Abstract: Personal AI agents are increasingly capable of handling long-horizon tasks across applications, yet users often need to invest substantial effort in specifying goals, resolving ambiguity, and verifying outcomes. We argue that progress should be measured by how effectively agents amplify human agency: enabling people to pursue their goals with less routine supervision while retaining control over consequential decisions. We advocate Avatar Intelligence, a paradigm of persistent personal agents that represent users’ goals, values, and constraints through sustained decision delegation across contexts and time. We describe a maturity roadmap from human-directed execution to autonomous operation within delegated domains, and introduce the Agentic Oversight Index (AOI) as a framework for evaluating delivered value against agent-side operational cost and human oversight burden. We identify three core research challenges: identity-continuous personalization that carries user preferences across tasks, user-situated evolution through Rehearsal Engineering, and safety mechanisms that combine technical control with accountability and recourse. These directions define a research agenda for reliable decision delegation to personal agents across tasks and over time.

TL;DR: 论文审计多模态LLM多选题基准中隐藏在代码里的评分规则，复现8个基准的官方scorer并在5个开源VLM上比较。作者用盲审人类加LLM裁判恢复模型真实答案，发现同一输出仅因评分规则不同可使准确率最多变化22个百分点，且问题主要来自fallback、正则匹配、弃权和似然评分等不可靠规则。论文呼吁基准报告非合规率并采用至少两种评分规则。

Details

Motivation: 多模态LLM基准的评分规则常被随意选择且未经审视，却直接决定排行榜数字；论文旨在揭示评分器对评测结果的潜在影响并审计其可靠性。

Result: 在8个同行评审基准和5个开源VLM上复现官方评分器，评分规则单独可造成最多22个百分点准确率差异；干净选项字母输出时差异为0，最强非合规基准的评分伪影为0，非合规为0.000的推理模型仍可因正则匹配不同摆动9.5个百分点；人工与LLM裁判一致性Cohen’s kappa=0.956。

Insight: 创新点在于将评分规则作为受控变量系统审计，结合盲审裁决恢复真实答案，揭示fallback、最近选项吸附、弃权和似然评分会混淆能力与运气；客观看，其价值在于把评测可信度问题从数据集扩展到评分协议，并提出报告非合规率和至少两种规则的实践建议。

Abstract: Every multimodal-LLM multiple-choice benchmark ends with a scoring rule that converts a model’s response, often free-form text rather than a clean option letter, into a right/wrong verdict, buried in its code. Unlike the dataset, this rule is chosen without justification and left unexamined, yet it sets the published number. We reproduce the official scorers of eight peer-reviewed benchmarks on five open vision-language models (VLMs) that fit a single 16 GB GPU, and introduce a blinded human-plus-LLM-judge adjudication (Cohen’s kappa=0.956) that recovers what the model actually answered. The scoring rule alone moves accuracy by up to 22 points on identical outputs, yet exactly 0 wherever a model emits clean option letters, so it hides on strong-model leaderboards. It is the fallback and not the rambling that does the damage: the benchmark with the highest non-compliance we measure has an artifact of exactly zero, because its scorer abstains instead of guessing; a reasoning model with non-compliance 0.000 still swings 9.5 points with which regex match of its trace the parser keeps. No standard rule is reliable: snapping a non-answer to its closest option credits answers never given yet buries correct ones, abstention discards answers stated in words, and likelihood scoring follows answer-token priors, so a single grade conflates capability with luck rather than measuring either. Abstract: A model is only half of an AI agent system. The other half is the inference strategy: the reasoning procedure that turns model calls into a response. Today that second half is written by hand, and the experience of building one strategy never carries to the next. We introduce Strategist, a meta-agent that evolves inference strategies across tasks. Each strategy is written as a blueprint,executable code that other strategies can reuse, and together the blueprints form a library. Given a task and a small development set, Strategist retrieves related blueprints, writes candidate strategies, tests them on real samples, and revises them from the results. Every candidate then enters the library, so later tasks build on earlier discoveries. On 30 benchmarks, Strategist beats the strongest baseline on 24 and matches its average accuracy (74.7% vs.74.0%) at 39% lower inference cost. Its strategies also transfer to unseen tasks and other models without further search. The part of an AI system that is not improved on its own now does.

Abstract: GUI web agents require realistic and interactive environments that remain stable during both evaluation and training. Live website evaluation suffers from changing content, access restrictions, and limited coverage of authenticated workflows, while existing synthetic environments for training often lack functional depth and visual fidelity. We propose WebHarbor, a suite of 153 executable and dockerized website environments that faithfully reconstruct the visual interfaces, content, and functional workflows of real-world web services under deterministic control. We build WebHarbor through task-driven human-agent collaboration, where environments evolve as new tasks expand their functional scope, coding agents implement the required changes, and human contributors audit visual fidelity, functional correctness, and task validity. The resulting suite comprises 3,518 tasks spanning multi-step and post-authentication workflows, where existing works often fail to cover. Beyond reliable evaluation, WebHarbor provides high-fidelity synthetic web environments for cost-efficient reinforcement learning (RL). We demonstrate that a Qwen 4B-level GUI agent trained with RL in WebHarbor generalizes to unseen tasks and performs competitively with leading open-source GUI web agents across four benchmarks. The code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/aiming-lab/WebHarbor.

Abstract: Defense systems for maritime assets must distinguish approaching benign craft from uncrewed surface vessels (USVs) with sufficient warning to act. Shore cameras using computer vision can separate hostile vessels from benign traffic, but these systems may be attacked using an adversarial hull patch or physical disguise. We evaluate adversarial hull patches and find they suppress detection in up to 29% of attempts but never cause misclassification as benign. Physical disguise, however, can bypass both a camera check and a radar presence check. To evaluate defenses, we develop a hybrid replay protocol from automatic identification system (AIS) tracks that combines recorded benign motion with direct or off-axis attack run-ins. We find that for recreational-labeled vessels attacking via direct run-in within 4 nautical miles, an asset-relative closing-rate check flags 94-95% at 15-20 knots, compared with 12% for a track-only speed check. The checks are complementary on off-axis approaches, constraining the attacker to remain below both thresholds and extending the time required to reach the asset. Abstract: Language models can analyze and assess student texts using predefined rubrics and deliver structured feedback, reducing instructors’ workload. However, existing solutions often rely on external services that are resource-intensive, costly, and raise privacy concerns, making them unsuitable for constrained environments. This study evaluates an automated assessment pipeline with three key aims: design for low-resource environments, privacy, and focus on a novel context in cybersecurity education. The pipeline integrates lightweight language models for textual evaluation and a vision-language model for image interpretation. Responses from 105 students were collected over two semesters of an undergraduate course during a cybersecurity exercise on incident response. Results across different hardware configurations show that small models in low-resource environments can achieve up to 97% accuracy in text-only and up to 94% in rich-text assessments. This rivals or even outperforms a large model while adding the benefits of locally hosted assessment. Our solution can help educators and practitioners who need grading assistance without replacing human oversight, especially in environments where cloud-based solutions may be impractical. This study contributes an open-source, locally deployable AI-assisted scoring pipeline that runs on affordable hardware and can be extended to various types of student reports in computing education. As a result, it makes automated assessment accessible to a broad range of educators and institutions.

Abstract: Automated exploratory data analysis (EDA) systems can execute statistics correctly while producing misleading interpretations. For example, correlations may be driven by influential observations, and mean differences may arise from skewness, overlap, or sparse subgroups rather than broad distributional shifts. We present EDAgent, a sequential framework that performs targeted visual verification before report synthesis. For each finding, the system records the statistical result, generates a visualization request identifying relevant distributional features, creates the corresponding chart, and uses the observed pattern to retain, qualify, or reconsider the interpretation. We call this process statistical-visual verification. EDAgent includes VisPlan, an 8B-parameter model that converts visualization rationales into detailed chart plans. We evaluate 87 end-to-end reports on EDA-Bench using a six-dimension rubric and GPT-5.1 multimodal evaluation. Maximum-score proportions reached 87.4% for factuality and visual consistency, 93.1% for statistical-visual cross-validation, and 96.6% for analytical narrative. On 166 open-ended VisEval tasks, VisPlan improved the mean overall score from 4.55 (Qwen3-8B) to 4.62, with the largest gain in aesthetics. These descriptive results indicate that visual verification can make automated EDA reports more transparent about how statistical findings relate to underlying data structure.

Motivation: 多数 LLM 写作反馈系统只评估最终提交文本，而 process-aware 系统虽可纳入中间草稿和交互记录，但尚不清楚学习者是否认为这些反馈有用、公平且符合自身修订体验。

Abstract: Large language models increasingly provide formative writing feedback, but most systems evaluate only the submitted text. Participants completed a timed essay, received LLM-generated feedback based on the final essay, intermediate snapshots, and keystroke-derived records, and then answered six five-point Likert items and four open-ended questions. Ratings were concentrated above the neutral midpoint across all six items. Between 74.4% and 95.3% of participants selected ratings of 4 or 5, and all six one-sided exact sign tests remained significant after Holm correction. Perceived correspondence between the revision analysis and the participant’s reported thought process was positively associated with overall perceived usefulness, Spearman’s $ρ_s=.327$, 95% bootstrap CI $[.009,.609]$, $p=.032$, $n=43$. Qualitative responses were analysed through an LLM-assisted codebook development procedure followed by independent human coding of 14 binary codes. Participants frequently described the product feedback and revision rationale as accurate, while a smaller set reported misinterpretation of surface corrections, time constraints, or rhetorical intention. Details

Motivation: 支持盲人和低视力个体独立出行的辅助技术长期发展缓慢，从白手杖、导盲犬到电子旅行辅助、深度学习和边缘AI不断演进，但快速算法进展尚未充分转化为现实采用。综述旨在梳理领域技术演进、系统架构和评估问题，为以用户为中心、社会可接受的辅助导航提供路线图。

Insight: 创新点在于以技术时代划分辅助导航领域，并将模型优化技术整合为统一技术参考，涵盖四类检测器和十二种压缩策略。客观来看，其价值在于揭示算法性能与真实用户采用之间的鸿沟，强调标准化评估、盲人和低视力用户参与以及隐私保护感知，为边缘AI辅助导航研究提供结构化视角。

Abstract: Independent mobility is a foundational requirement for the autonomy of blind and low-vision (BLV) individuals, yet the assistive technologies that support it have historically evolved slowly. This survey systematically reviews 108 peer-reviewed studies published between 2008 and 2026, organizing the field into four technological eras: (i) a foundational era of passive mechanical aids, namely the white cane and the guide dog; (ii) a hardware era of electronic travel aids built on ultrasonic, infrared, and satellite positioning sensors that alert users to proximity but lack semantic understanding; (iii) a deep learning era in which convolutional and transformer-based detectors introduced context-aware scene understanding, initially tethered to cloud infrastructure; and (iv) a contemporary edge-native era defined by model compression, quantization, hardware acceleration, and multi-sensor fusion that relocate intelligence onto resource-constrained wearable and mobile devices. For each era we analyze representative systems, sensing modalities, computational architectures, and reported performance, and we consolidate the field’s model-optimization techniques into a single technical reference spanning four detector families and twelve compression strategies. Across the corpus, we find a persistent mismatch between rapid algorithmic progress and slow real-world adoption, driven by cognitive overload in user interfaces, fragmented evaluation protocols, and the scarcity of studies involving BLV participants. We conclude with open challenges, including seamless indoor-outdoor transition, standardized benchmarks, privacy-preserving perception, and the emerging role of multimodal foundation models, and outline a roadmap for socially acceptable, user-centered assistive navigation.

Abstract: We present GazeTags, a camera- and computer-vision-free approach for worn head-gaze object awareness. Our small electronic tags cost roughly $2 each and can operate for more than a year on a coin cell battery. They work in concert with a user-worn device (smartglasses, hearables, etc.) that periodically emits a focused infrared signal aligned with the user’s head direction. Only GazeTags within that narrow head-oriented beam wake and respond, providing their identity and optional payloads such as object state or live sensor readings. By avoiding cameras and computer vision pipelines, our approach is very energy efficient, able to operate continuously even in battery-constrained wearables, and sidesteps non-trivial privacy issues. We describe our hardware design, characterize our system performance and operating tradeoffs, and demonstrate how GazeTags can enable practical gaze-aware environments.

Abstract: A spectrum can be given to a model as a table in nanometers or as a plot in photon energy, and the decision should not depend on which one it sees. When the data needed for an answer are missing, the model should say so. We test representation invariance and abstention on measured optical spectra of silicon metasurfaces (MOCLIP) and gold nanoparticles, with labels computed from the data. Each spectrum is shown as four tables (nm, $μ$m, scientific notation, eV) and two plots (nm, eV), and partial spectra remove data inside or outside the queried range. We evaluate the decision models d3-nano and Jev 1.13, three GPT-6 Luna configurations and the Qwen3.5-2B base model. Changing only the representation moves accuracy by up to 41 percentage points within one model, mostly on photon-energy tables and plots. With the same evidence, asking in photon energy instead of wavelength helps some model-view pairs by 16-50 points and hurts others by up to 25. When the relevant extremum is removed, unadapted models rarely answer “undetermined”. LoRA fine-tuning of d3-nano improves comparisons on the trained table formats, but much of its gain on unanswerable questions comes from a shortcut: it abstains whenever the input is truncated. Training with answerable truncations avoids the shortcut in all six seeds, with a 90-100 point gap between abstention after inside and outside cuts on held-out structures; with the same amount of extra original-task data, five of six seeds keep the shortcut. On gold spectra the two training sets perform similarly. Multimodal language models used for scientific decisions should be tested on equivalent representations and on missing evidence, not only on average accuracy. We release the tasks, per-response results and analysis code.

Abstract: Language agents read code, tool output, and dialogue in contexts that grow at every step. Dynamic sparse attention lets a small indexer choose the earlier tokens each query attends to, but the indexer still scores the whole prefix at every layer. In an agent, the relevant evidence can change abruptly when a traceback or test result arrives, so fresh selections matter more at some steps than at others. We propose Adaptive Index Reuse (AIR), which keeps IndexCache’s execution and learns, for each segment of an agent episode, how many layers refresh their selection. A small controller reads signals from completed computation and the latest tool event, chooses a pattern from a nested library, and learns from terminal task reward under an expected compute budget. On Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 with a 128K context, AIR improves success over the strongest static schedule at matched cost on SWE-bench Verified (27.0% to 32.4%), Terminal-Bench 2.0, and three $τ^2$-bench domains, and it lowers time per successful task on all five. Across 50 backbone, context, and benchmark settings, it matches or exceeds that schedule in 44.

Motivation: 人类能从书籍和教学视频中持续获取知识并迁移到未来任务，而LLM智能体在训练后能力被冻结，大规模参数更新成本高昂，难以利用互联网上不断增长的教学视频资源。论文旨在探索LLM智能体能否在无参数更新的条件下，从海量教学视频中进行持续学习。

Insight: 论文的主要创新在于提出无参数更新的非参数持续学习范式，将教学视频固化为结构化、可检索的tutorialbook记忆，并通过两阶段对抗过程生成困难视频 grounded 问题以精炼记忆；同时用TOC树将检索与模型推理过程绑定，而非依赖嵌入相似度。客观来看，结合视频知识结构化、对抗式记忆精炼和推理驱动检索是其可借鉴之处。

Abstract: Humans continuously acquire knowledge from carefully crafted materials such as books and tutorial videos, carrying that understanding into future tasks. Millions of such instructional videos are uploaded online every day, yet LLM agents remain unable to exploit this ever-expanding wealth of human teaching. Their capabilities are frozen after training, while parameter updates at scale remain prohibitively expensive. This raises the central question: can LLM agents learn from this vast instructional resource without parameter updates? We introduce Tutorial Agentic Learning (TAL), a nonparametric continual-learning paradigm that consolidates tutorial videos into a persistent, structured tutorialbook memory through a two-stage adversarial process that harvests hard, video-grounded questions and uses them to refine the memory. At inference time, TAL retrieves through a Table-of-Contents (TOC) tree, tying retrieval directly to the model’s reasoning rather than to embedding similarity. To study this setting, we introduce VidLearn, a multimodal QA benchmark built from 72 chess tutorial videos spanning 12 openings. On VidLearn, TAL outperforms all evaluated baselines and improves monotonically as more videos are consumed, achieving up to 113% and 91% relative gains over the corresponding vanilla MLLMs on the training and test splits, respectively. In actual gameplay, TAL reaches a stronger opening-phase position than its vanilla counterpart in 69% of head-to-head games. Evaluation in a second domain further demonstrates the generality of TAL. Together, these results highlight instructional videos as a scalable resource for parameter-update-free agent continual learning.

Khandokar Md. Rahat Hossain, Souvik Das, Tahsina Hashem, Mohammed Eunus Ali, Tanzima Hashem

Motivation: 传统房价预测主要依赖卧室数、浴室数、停车位等结构化数据，忽略了文本描述和房产照片中的丰富上下文与语义视觉信息；已有深度多模态方法也未能充分提取文本中的时空上下文特征和图像中的语义视觉信息。

Abstract: Accurate house price prediction is essential for real estate buyers, sellers, agents, and financial institutions. Traditional methods rely primarily on structured data, e.g., number of bedrooms, bathrooms, parkings, but they overlook rich contextual information embedded in textual descriptions and property photos. Previous deep learning approaches for house price prediction have fused multimodal data but they fall short to extract structured spatio-temporal and contextual features from texts and semantic visual information from images. In this paper, we introduce a novel multimodal framework that addresses these limitations by systematically integrating structured attributes, textual descriptions, and visual images of properties to achieve higher prediction accuracy while maintaining interpretability. We use a large language model to derive domain-specific spatio-temporal and contextual features from text, and an unsupervised vision-language approach to automatically group photos into meaningful classes like indoor, outdoor, mixed, or floorplan, that are commonly present in real-world house listings. These categories are created without manual labeling by aligning image clusters with carefully designed pseudo text prompts. We fuse all features into a unified representation and use an optimized regressor to predict prices. Experiments on a large real-world property dataset demonstrate that our method outperforms traditional methods and existing multimodal baselines. Ablation studies confirm that the novel textual feature extraction and categorized visual embeddings substantially contribute to more accurate and reliable price predictions.

[275] CREDO: Evidence-Conditioned Credit Assignment for Temporal Reasoning Agents cs.LG | cs.AI | cs.CL | cs.IRPDF

Yue Leng, Shengtao Wen, Xiang Chen, Xinyi Zeng, Yu Tian

TL;DR: 论文针对时序知识图谱问答（TKGQA）中语言模型智能体多步推理的信用分配问题，提出CREDO框架。该方法利用中间证据恢复局部监督，在同题多次采样轨迹间比较分配阶段级正信用，并用保留答案重叠作为机会代理重新分配部分结果策略权重，从而缓解GRPO轨迹级奖励无法区分中间决策质量及全失败组无相对信号的问题。

Details

Motivation: 现有GRPO式轨迹级结果信号不能细粒度评价中间证据检索与推理步骤，下游失败可能误罚有用证据获取；全失败组奖励相同也会丢失相对结果信号。论文旨在为多步时序推理智能体提供更合理的中间信用分配。

Insight: 创新点在于用中间证据条件化信用分配，在包括全失败组的采样轨迹中恢复局部监督，并通过阶段级正信用与答案重叠机会代理将部分结果监督权重转向推理和回答，同时保持终端奖励和轨迹级优势及总策略权重守恒。

Abstract: Temporal Knowledge Graph Question Answering (TKGQA) requires language model agents to retrieve evidence, select relevant facts, and perform multi-step temporal reasoning. However, the trajectory-level outcome signal in GRPO does not explicitly distinguish the quality of intermediate decisions: downstream failures can penalize useful evidence acquisition, while identical rewards in all-failed groups eliminate the relative outcome signal despite differences in intermediate progress. We propose Credit Redistribution with Evidence-Driven Opportunities (CREDO), which uses intermediate evidence to recover local supervision, including in all-failed groups, and determine where outcome supervision acts. CREDO assigns positive stage-level credit through comparisons among rollouts of the same question and uses retained answer overlap as an opportunity proxy to shift part of the outcome-policy weight toward reasoning and answering. The framework preserves terminal rewards and trajectory-level advantages, while redistribution conserves total outcome-policy weight per trajectory. Following the public evaluation protocol of prior work, CREDO raises Overall accuracy from 78.0% to 82.4% and Multiple accuracy from 55.0% to 65.6% on MultiTQ relative to the strongest published baseline in our comparison. On TimelineKGQA, it raises cross-KG accuracy from 30.9% to 36.4% relative to our reproduced baseline via direct transfer to ICEWS Actor under matched training and evaluation settings.

TL;DR: 论文提出仅顺序同策略蒸馏（O$^{3}$PD）：在学生模型自己生成的每个前缀上，不再拟合教师模型的token概率值，而是让学生的前K个token排序与教师一致。该方法对教师温度不敏感、无需调温，并在多个师生模型对上优于传统同策略蒸馏（OPD）。

Details

Motivation: 传统OPD通过匹配教师token概率来蒸馏，但概率值同时包含教师偏好和置信度，置信度受教师容量与校准影响，小模型难以复现，且会随教师温度变化而导致OPD对温度敏感。论文因此探究：仅保留教师候选token的排序是否已足够。

Insight: 创新点在于用教师top-K token的排序而非概率值作为同策略蒸馏监督，使目标对教师温度不变并免去温度调参；客观上看，该工作将蒸馏知识从概率幅值解耦为序数关系，说明排序信息比概率值更关键。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own generations by matching the teacher’s token probabilities. These probabilities entangle two kinds of information: which tokens the teacher prefers, and how confident it is. The latter reflects the teacher’s own capacity and calibration, which a smaller student may be unable to reproduce. Because the teacher temperature changes these values without changing the ordering, OPD is also sensitive to the temperature choice. We ask whether the teacher’s ordering of candidate tokens is enough, and propose Order-Only On-Policy Distillation (O$^{3}$PD). At each student-generated prefix, O$^{3}$PD trains the student to reproduce the order of the teacher’s top-$K$ tokens, without fitting their probability values. The objective is therefore invariant to the teacher temperature and needs no temperature tuning. Across six teacher–student pairs, O$^{3}$PD outperforms OPD on the average over HMMT25, AIME24, and AIME25 in every pair, by up to 2.9 points, with gains of up to 5.6 points on AIME25. Other ranking losses yield similar gains, so the benefit comes from ordinal supervision itself. Analysis shows that O$^{3}$PD departs further from the teacher’s probabilities than OPD, yet reproduces its ranking more faithfully and yields a stronger student. The ranking, not the probability values, thus carries the knowledge that on-policy distillation needs to transfer.

Adam Y. Ahmed, Abdullah G. Elafifi

TL;DR: 论文研究小模型在开放式推理任务上的测试时扩展问题，提出一种无需奖励模型或自评判的语义聚类投票方法：按语义对模型多样本分组，并返回最大簇代表。实验发现该方法在数学等可验证任务上能显著提升准确率，但在开放式文本生成上几乎无效，原因是大模型/指令模型的开放式样本高度同质化，几乎都落入同一语义簇，缺少可供投票选择的多样性。

Details

Motivation: 投票聚合只有在样本存在分歧时才有价值，因此论文关注开放式生成中模型是否会产生“值得组合”的多样样本，而此前测试时扩展主要在数学任务上有效，对自由文本开放式推理仍缺乏系统研究。

Result: 在250个提示、三级答案可验证性基准上，三个小模型家族和两个随机种子下，语义聚类投票在数学控制任务上提升+10到+29分，但在开放式文本上最多仅提升+0.30 judge分；在主模型200题MATH-500上提升+8.5分（95% CI [+4.0, +13.0]）。开放式样本几乎都塌缩到单一语义簇，提高解码温度也无法恢复有效多样性，且净损失-0.64 judge分（95% CI [-0.93, -0.37]）。

Insight: 创新点在于提出无评判器的语义聚类投票聚合器，并系统评估小模型在开放式推理中的测试时扩展瓶颈。客观来看，论文的重要发现是：限制投票收益的关键不是聚合策略，而是小指令模型缺乏可用语义多样性；该同质化更可能与指令微调有关，而非模型规模，且简单提高温度不能解决。

Abstract: A vote over a model’s samples can only help when the samples disagree. For open-ended generation the binding question is therefore not how to combine samples but whether a model produces samples worth combining, a question test-time scaling has answered for math but not for free-form text. We study it at small scale with semantic cluster voting, a judge-free aggregator that groups a small instruct model’s samples by meaning and returns the largest cluster’s representative, with no reward model or self-judging. On a 250-prompt benchmark with three tiers of answer checkability, the same pattern holds across three model families (Qwen2.5-3B, Llama-3.2-3B, Gemma-2-2B) and two generation seeds: voting raises accuracy on the math control, where samples vary but stay checkable (a gain of +10 to +29 points across the three models), yet adds at most +0.30 judge points on open-ended text. On a larger 200-problem MATH-500 run with the primary model, the math gain is +8.5 points (95% CI [+4.0, +13.0]). Almost every open-ended sample falls into one meaning cluster, so there is little to select over. The collapse is consistent with instruction-tuning rather than model size, and raising decoding temperature does not recover usable diversity, because it costs more quality than it adds (net -0.64 judge points, 95% CI [-0.93, -0.37]).

[278] Concise-9B: Removing the Slack from a Reasoning Model’s Thinking cs.LG | cs.CLPDF

Alexander Boesgaard Lorup

TL;DR: 论文研究推理模型在答案已形成后仍继续生成冗余思考（slack）的问题，并在 Qwen3.5-9B 上提出两轮 on-policy 拒绝采样微调：保留最短正确样本并混入少量答案合成目标，得到 Concise-9B。该方法在多个基准上以约 0.66x token 达到与基座模型相当的准确率，同时分析了冗余思考的位置，并给出用于自适应采样的低成本 commit signal，但在超长思考的困难数学题上有轻微性能损失。

Details

Motivation: 推理模型思考更长通常答案更好，但大量思考发生在答案已经确定之后，造成推理成本浪费。论文希望在不牺牲准确率的情况下压缩这部分冗余思考，并定量刻画其占比和可利用信号。

Result: 在 8,983 道留出题（竞赛与困难数学、SuperGPQA、五领域确认集、MMLU-Pro）上，Concise-9B 在 32K thinking budget 下仅用 Qwen3.5-9B 的 0.66x token，准确率差异为 -0.20 [-0.77, +0.36] 点，在 ±1 点内等价。强制每 2,048 token 作答的分析显示，基座模型 54-64% 的思考 token 发生在答案形成后，Concise-9B 为 41-48%；其节省 token 中 86% 来自答案形成后。局限是延长到 80K token 时，在 1,276 道困难题上少解 25 题，主要集中于竞赛数学；自适应采样 commit signal 在预注册测试中以 0.67x token 匹配 two-sample escalation 的 ±1 点效果。

Insight: 论文的创新点在于显式度量“答案已形成后的冗余思考”，并用最短正确样本的 on-policy 拒绝采样自训练来压缩冗余，同时利用强制作答一致性构造廉价 commit signal 用于自适应采样。客观上看，其价值在于把推理长度优化从单纯蒸馏或 RL 转向冗余度量与数据筛选，并指出压缩收益依赖基座模型的冗长程度，但在超长思考硬题上存在性能边界。

Abstract: Reasoning models answer better when they think longer, but a thinking trace keeps going well after its answer has formed. We measure this slack in Qwen3.5-9B and remove most of it with concise self-training: two rounds of on-policy rejection-sampling fine-tuning that keep the shortest correct samples, plus a small share of answer-synthesis targets, giving Concise-9B. On 8,983 held-out problems (competition and hard mathematics, SuperGPQA, a five-area confirmation set and MMLU-Pro), Concise-9B generates 0.66x the tokens of Qwen3.5-9B at a 32K thinking budget, with accuracy equivalent within +/-1 point (-0.20 [-0.77, +0.36] points). Forcing each trace on the hard and confirmation sets to answer every 2,048 thinking tokens, we find that 54-64% of Qwen3.5-9B’s thinking tokens come after the point from which every forced answer equals the final one (41-48% for Concise-9B). Stopping there would keep every answer at 0.35-0.44x the base model’s tokens, but finding that point takes hindsight: stopping when three consecutive forced answers agree costs the base model 2.4-9.2 points. Concise self-training removes slack without that cost: 86% [83, 90] of the thinking tokens it saves come after the answer has formed. It has a limit: with traces continued to 80K tokens, Concise-9B solves 25 fewer of 1,276 hard problems (-25 [-49, -1]), mostly in competition mathematics. The measurement also yields a cheap commit signal for adaptive sampling that matched two-sample escalation within +/-1 point at 0.67x its tokens in a pre-registered test. Results on Qwen3.5-4B, on which the recipe was developed, and a replication on Olmo-3-7B-Think suggest that the saving depends on how verbose the base model is.

[279] Do Visual RL Gains Scale at Test Time? A Quantile View of Post-Training cs.LG | cs.CVPDF

Austin Wang, Lexing Ying

TL;DR: 论文系统研究视觉生成模型在RL后训练后，其收益能否在Best-of-N等测试时推理扩展下保持。作者发现更高单样本奖励不一定带来更好的质量-计算前沿，RL收益在大采样预算下可能衰减、饱和甚至反转。论文用分位数迁移框架解释该现象，并提出QUPO，通过优化不同推理预算对应的分位数效用混合来保留高质量上尾样本。

Details

Motivation: 视觉生成模型常用RL后训练提升单样本质量，但实际部署可通过Best-of-N增加推理计算；现有理解不足的是RL收益在测试时扩展下、尤其在困难留出任务上是否仍然有效。

Result: 在SD3.5-M和BAGEL上，覆盖组合生成、文本渲染和偏好对齐等评估，QUPO相较标准RL后训练更好地保留上尾质量，并显著改善困难留出提示下的缩放表现；摘要未给出具体数值。

Insight: 核心创新是识别并刻画视觉RL在测试时缩放中的收益迁移失败模式，并用分位数迁移解释Best-of-N对大采样预算下reward分布上尾的依赖；QUPO将不同推理预算对应的分位数效用混合优化，提示应以后训练对完整reward分布和质量-计算前沿的影响来评价与优化生成模型。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training improves the single-sample quality of visual generative models, but deployment often provides additional inference compute through Best-of-N sampling. Whether RL gains transfer under such test-time scaling, particularly on difficult held-out tasks, remains poorly understood in the visual domain. Our central contribution is to systematically identify and characterize a failure mode of scaling transfer in visual RL: across multiple RL methods, model backbones, and evaluations spanning compositional generation, text rendering, and preference alignment, higher single-sample reward does not necessarily imply a better quality-compute frontier. RL gains may attenuate, saturate, or even reverse at large sampling budgets, with the base model eventually outperforming its post-trained counterpart. We explain these regimes through a quantile-transfer framework, showing that Best-of-N places increasing weight on the upper tail of the reward distribution as N grows. Consequently, RL can improve typical samples while compressing or degrading the rare high-quality outcomes that test-time scaling exploits. As a simple intervention motivated by this analysis, we introduce Quantile Utility Policy Optimization (QUPO), which optimizes a controllable mixture of quantile utilities corresponding to different inference budgets. Experiments on SD3.5-M and BAGEL show that QUPO better preserves upper-tail quality and substantially improves scaling on challenging held-out prompts relative to standard RL post-training. Our results suggest that visual generative models should be evaluated and optimized not only for single-sample quality, but for how post-training reshapes the full reward distribution that inference-time scaling exploits.

[280] ViAdminShift: A Vietnamese Benchmark for Event-Level Knowledge Updates Built from the 2025 Administrative Reform cs.LG | cs.CLPDF

Phan Binh Nguyen Lam, Nguyen Thai Anh

TL;DR: ViAdminShift 是一个越南语事件级知识更新基准，基于2025年越南行政区划改革构建，包含7,995个评测项、2,281个改革前后维基百科修订检索段落及新旧地址映射表，并设计探测赛道和基准赛道来评估模型是否掌握改革后知识。论文还系统分析了模型对旧地址的过时回答、日期提示和推理设置的影响。

Details

Motivation: 大模型的知识可能随真实世界事件而过时，尤其越南2025年省级和基层行政区划大规模调整会造成大量地址映射变化，现有基准缺乏针对该事件级知识更新的越南语评测资源。

Result: 探测赛道中至少20/67个模型知道该改革；对旧地址的普通问题，14个模型最多仅11%单独给出新省，而单独给出旧省的比例为14-100%，仅给日期可使比例最高达100%；在1,262项基准子集中，不知改革的小模型产生14-30%过时答案，五个知道改革的模型为0-5%。映射表与独立谱系在10,564/10,565对官方配对一致，评分者与作者盲标一致性κ为0.91和0.89。

Insight: 创新点在于用真实官方改革事件构建事件级知识更新基准，结合改革前后同源维基检索段落、未变单位对照的2×2设计和无变音符号地址等扰动，并同时评测模型知识掌握、旧答案残留及日期/推理提示下的行为偏差；数据、脚本和datasheet的发布也增强了可复现性。

Abstract: On July 1, 2025, Vietnam reduced its 63 provinces to 34, abolished its 696 districts, and replaced its 10,035 commune-level units (wards) with 3,321. ViAdminShift, a Vietnamese language resource about this event, consists of 7,995 benchmark items, 2,281 retrieval passages from pre- and post-reform Wikipedia revisions and dated templates, and old-to-new tables that a released script rebuilds from the official conversion table (not redistributed). Changed items store the pre-reform answer (except 121 address items), a $2\times2$ design uses untouched units as controls, and 400 addresses appear without diacritics. The tables agree with an independent lineage on 10,564 of 10,565 official pairs, disagreements were settled against the resolutions, and the probing-track scorer agrees with both authors’ blind labels (Cohen’s $κ=0.91$ and $0.89$). Data, outputs, code, and a datasheet are released. In the probing track, at least 20 of 67 models know the reform. Fourteen of them give the new province alone for at most 11% of plain questions about old addresses (old province only: 14-100%); a bare date recovers up to 100%. Abstract: A frontier language model was recently reported to solve 1D NMR structural elucidation without tools. We ask whether this capability transfers to tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS) in the de novo setting, where the model must propose a structure directly from the spectrum without a candidate list or reference library. To separate reasoning from recall, we build a 100-analyte benchmark from MassSpecGym, split by each analyte’s textual footprint into in-distribution (well documented in literature) and out-of-distribution (essentially undocumented) arms. We hold the model, harness, and output format fixed and vary only the LLM’s access to domain-specific tools. Without tools, a frontier LLM reaches 52% Top-1 accuracy in-distribution but only 2% out-of-distribution. Only access to de novo structure generators improves out-of-distribution accuracy, raising it to as much as 38% Top-1, and the resulting agent outperforms the standalone de novo models both in and out of distribution. These results suggest that LLMs are not effective at de novo MS/MS structural elucidation on their own, and that further gains depend on the specialist tools available to the agent rather than on the LLM itself.

Abstract: Computer programmers chain together the same reusable computational primitives, for example, conditional statements or loops, but in different orders to implement different algorithms. In contrast, existing language model architectures always execute their layers in the same order. We introduce Library of Layers (LoL), an architecture that dynamically orders its layers during inference to solve the problem at hand. LoL has a single hyperparameter, the size of its global library of transformer blocks, that allows it to transition seamlessly between parameter reuse and sparsity, generalizing the parameter-efficiency and FLOPs-efficiency tradeoffs of dense, depth-recurrent, and mixture of experts architectures in one unified family. We show that LoL achieves competitive performance with all three above baselines when pretrained on text data. On synthetic sudoku and maze data, we observe that the model employs distinct layer orderings to implement different solution strategies, and we can intervene on routing to force a model to apply a specific solution strategy to a problem instance. In a multilingual natural language setting, we find that LoL chooses different layer order patterns based on language and script. Similarly, we train LoL on safety data and fit probes to its router outputs, finding that these probes distinguish safe from unsafe text with high AUROC. LoL provides a path toward a future in which models dynamically compose their own computational graph, enabling more efficient and controllable reasoning.

Abstract: Resource managers typically encode what to do in a task-specific policy—a heuristic, an optimization procedure, or a model trained for the task—that must be developed before use and may need revision as the workload or system changes. We propose bypassing policy development and instead asking pretrained models to make resource-management decisions directly, given the current system state, desired outcome, and available choices. We evaluate this approach on microservice autoscaling, DRAM sizing, and video encoding, using a frontier LLM and two small decision models. On two microservice applications, a small decision model meets latency targets while using within 10% of the replicas allocated by policy-based autoscalers and within 13% of the frontier LLM. In DRAM sizing, a small decision model reduces DRAM usage by up to 27.5% relative to static provisioning while maintaining at least 95% of baseline performance. In video encoding, it completes encodes up to 4.3$\times$ faster than the frontier LLM, with an imperceptible 1.1-point decrease in Video Multi-Method Assessment Fusion (VMAF), a metric of perceptual video quality. Making individual resource-management decisions may be considerably simpler than developing a general strategy for making them.

Motivation: 传统具身智能体通常围绕单个任务设计，难以应对任务之间及执行过程中不断变化的物理世界；论文希望机器人通过持续经验积累变得更熟悉环境、更具能力，而不仅是完成预设任务。

Insight: 创新点在于将持续观察、事件触发式选择性记忆、保留源证据的可扩展记忆存储，以及从问题求解中蒸馏可复用工具/技能整合为终身具身学习闭环；其中流式门控决定何时响应或写入记忆、以及经验到技能的验证与复用机制较有借鉴价值。

Abstract: Embodied agents are usually organized around individual tasks, yet the physical world keeps changing between tasks and during execution. We introduce LIFE (Lifelong Intelligence from Experience), a framework in which a robot observes continuously, remembers selectively, and turns experience into new capabilities. RoboBeats, a family of lightweight streaming gates, tracks conditions set by the agent and discovers new events, deciding when an observation warrants a response or a memory write. Selected observations enter Plastic Memory, a flat store of images and structured records that keeps the source evidence, so new fields and indexes can be added when later questions need them. When existing tools fall short, Explore-Distill-Mount (EDM) turns solutions found during problem solving into validated, reusable tools and skills. Under matched protocols, RoboBeats substantially improves condition tracking over its base models and, at the same writing budget, retains more useful evidence for memory question answering than uniform sampling. A case study of limited scale, replaying 24 hours of continuous video recorded by a real robot, illustrates how the integrated system builds memory from a day of experience and uses it to answer everyday questions. LIFE takes a step toward robots that become more familiar with their surroundings and more capable through experience: learning not only to complete tasks, but to live in the world.

Xiao Huang, Ya Zhang, Weidi Xie

Abstract: A robot’s next action can depend on recent motion or earlier visual evidence absent from its current observation. A recurrent visual-memory architecture can retain this history in a visual state, but its usefulness depends on what the state represents and how it is updated with new observations. We introduce Prediction-Regulated Memory (PREM), a framework that uses action-conditioned future prediction to guide both memory learning and updating in vision-language-action policies. During training, predicting future visual features provides temporal supervision for memory learning. During execution, PREM compares current visual features with the prediction made at the preceding decision and uses the spatially normalized prediction discrepancy to regulate updates to the visual state at each spatial location. The updated visual state supplies temporal context for action generation alongside current observations. Built on $π_{0.5}$, PREM improves average success rate from 9.63% to 20.74% on DOMINO dynamic manipulation tasks and from 14.4% to 83.8% on the RMBench M(1) memory-dependent setting. Further evaluations on LIBERO and LIBERO-Pro show improvements in general manipulation and robustness to spatial perturbations. PREM incurs a mean inference overhead of 7.7 ms on a single NVIDIA H800 GPU.

Abstract: Diffusion-based vision-language-action (VLA) models cascade pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) with diffusion action experts, but typically restrict the VLM to providing static conditioning. This separation limits how much pretrained perception and reasoning can guide action generation, especially in out-of-distribution settings. We introduce JADE, a Joint Action DEnoiser that enables the VLM and action expert to jointly refine actions. Our key insight is that structured action latents allow the VLM to read the current noisy action together with visual observations and language instructions. At every denoising step, the VLM contextualizes the noisy action and guides the action expert through gated cross-attention, so that its guidance evolves with the action being generated. We further supervise the VLM to recover clean action latents from noisy ones, which gives it a direct action-learning signal and couples perception with control. Additionally, joint denoising enables JADE to generate actions with fewer sampling steps, helping offset the additional cost of VLM participation. An adaptive step-size schedule further balances task performance and inference latency. On RoboDojo, JADE achieves an average success rate of 12.67%, the highest among the evaluated $π_{0.5}$-based methods, and is competitive with recent VLA and WAM foundation models pretrained at scale. It also improves performance on RoboTwin 2.0 and raises the average success rate across four real-world bimanual tasks by 20.8 percentage points compared with $π_{0.5}$.

Abstract: Robots manipulating in cluttered spaces must often plan from partial views where foreground objects occlude the target, surrounding geometry, and usable free space. Reactive policies often miss these hidden constraints, while exhaustive search becomes computationally prohibitive in dense clutter. We present SCOUT, an occlusion-aware planning framework that bridges high-level deliberation with grounded physical rollouts. SCOUT leverages an object-centric scene representation to reconstruct hidden geometry and derive a relational planning state capturing blocker hierarchies and accessibility corridors. To navigate the vast action space in clutter, an LLM proposes structured action candidates which are then rigorously evaluated via Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) using a learned action-conditioned world model. Evaluations on ‘Reveal’ and ‘Placement’ tasks show that SCOUT outperforms Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies, embodied agents, and 3D world models, with significant gains in long-horizon tasks requiring reasoning over occluded geometry. We further validate the framework’s robustness through real-world robotic manipulation in a cluttered shelf environment.

TL;DR: 论文针对具身问答（EQA）中仅看答案准确率无法判断智能体是否真的导航并观察到证据的问题，构建了一个包含200个测试回合、800个问题的多房间基准，并提出逐级控制证据供给的评估阶梯。实验发现闭环视觉语言智能体在200个回合中未到达任何目标却仍能答对45.5%的问题，与不给图像时几乎相同；重放参考轨迹可将同一模型提升到57.4%，说明证据存在于路线中但未被采集。

Abstract: Embodied question answering asks an agent to navigate, observe, and then answer questions about what it saw, yet answer accuracy alone cannot tell whether any of this happened. A plausible answer can come from the question, the room label, or the answer choices, and a correct answer does not show that the supporting observation was ever made. We present a multi-room benchmark whose 200 test episodes and 800 questions are stratified by route extent, with an evaluation ladder that holds the questions fixed while varying only the evidence supplied to the answerer, from text-only probes through closed-loop agents to replay of the reference trajectory. Questions are generated from symbolic records of rooms, visible objects, and frames, so every answer can be traced to the observations that support it. A closed-loop vision-language agent reaches no target in 200 episodes yet answers 45.5% of questions, within 0.1 points of the same model given no images; replaying the reference trajectory raises the same model to 57.4%, so the evidence exists along the route but is not gathered. A family-level audit then shows that access to evidence is not the same as use of it. Four of eight families are largely answerable from text, one cites frames that cannot establish its own answer, and the oracle conditions reach 59.5% on Rooms-visited by counting the supplied images. Evidence acquisition, answer coverage, and shortcut sensitivity must therefore be established before an accuracy gain can be credited to memory.

[289] Do Embodied VLMs Actually Use Their Scene-Graph Memory? cs.RO | cs.AI | cs.CVPDF

Shubh Garg, Divyansh Pandey, Vedant Khandelwal, Niyati Rawal, Amit Sheth

TL;DR: 论文提出一种图交换诊断测试，用来判断具身视觉语言模型是否真正依赖场景图记忆，而不仅是答案准确。作者在含2至7个房间路线的具身问答基准上比较不同场景图记忆注入方式，发现以文本形式提供时模型强烈使用记忆，路线问题提升30分；以图结构输入时标准池化和晚融合会丢弃信息，按节点逐token输入可恢复部分收益，路线问题提升8.3分。

Details

Motivation: 现有评测只看答案准确率，无法确认场景图是否包含经历事实、是否到达模型以及模型是否真正依赖它；论文希望诊断具身VLM是否实际使用其场景图记忆，并找出更有效的记忆注入方式。

Result: 在2至7个房间路线的具身问答基准上，文本形式场景图记忆使路线问题提升30分；图编码器虽保留信息，但池化和晚融合导致模型不利用，逐节点token输入带来8.3分提升且经交换测试确认来自图记忆。交换测试还揭示捷径：当相同事实出现在文本中时模型会忽略图。

Insight: 创新点在于用图交换测试直接衡量模型对场景图记忆的依赖，而非仅看准确率；客观上看，该诊断方法低成本且能暴露准确率掩盖的捷径，并指出场景图记忆应按节点保留细粒度信息、避免过早池化或晚融合。

Abstract: Embodied agents that answer questions about their route need a memory of what they saw, and scene graphs are a natural form for it. A vision-language model (VLM) can receive such a graph as text or through a graph encoder, but accuracy alone cannot show whether the graph holds the episode’s facts, reaches the model, or is actually relied on. In this diagnostic study, we introduce a graph-swap test for the last of these: each episode is given another episode’s graph, and we count how many answers change. On an embodied question-answering benchmark with routes through two to seven rooms, we use it to compare ways of delivering scene-graph memory to a fine-tuned VLM. As text, the memory is used strongly, adding 30 points on route questions. As a graph, it is not, and we trace why: the encoder preserves the information, but standard pooled and late fusion discard it. Giving each node its own input token recovers part of it, a gain of 8.3 points on route questions that the swap test confirms comes from the graph. The test also exposes a shortcut that accuracy hides: when the same facts appear in the text, the model ignores its graph. The test thus offers a cheap check of whether a VLM uses its scene-graph memory, and our analysis points to how that memory should be delivered.

TL;DR: 论文指出机器人基础模型的物理安全不是单一模型属性，而是环境、模型、计算平台与执行在闭环中跨层交互的结果。作者在 LIBERO 上用 pi0.5 视觉-语言-动作模型进行 4000 个配对闭环实验，发现推理延迟与相机视角偏移联合造成的安全违规风险远大于二者单独影响之和，并呼吁面向可预测物理智能，预测变异何时转化为风险并自适应调整计算、功耗与控制。

Details

Motivation: 现有机器人基础模型安全评估通常一次只扰动一个因素：鲁棒性基准扰动场景但假设即时推理，实时执行方法只在常规场景研究延迟，因而低估了闭环系统中多源变异联合作用带来的物理安全风险。

Result: 在 LIBERO 上 4000 个配对闭环 episodes 中，400 ms 推理延迟在训练视角下使安全违规率提高 3.5 个百分点，但在 60 度相机偏移下提高 37 个百分点；联合交互效应比两个单独效应之和多 33.5 个百分点（95% CI：25-43）。

Insight: 论文宣称的创新点是形式化跨层变异传播，并提出交互对比度量联合变异何时产生超过各部分之和的风险；客观来看，可借鉴之处在于将环境扰动、模型推理延迟、计算平台和执行控制纳入统一闭环安全评估，并用配对实验量化非线性交互风险。

Abstract: Robot foundation models now act in a closed loop, yet their safety is evaluated one variation at a time: robustness benchmarks perturb the scene while assuming instantaneous inference, and real-time execution methods study inference delay in nominal scenes. We argue that physical safety is not a property of the model alone, but emerges from how variations in the physical environment, the model, the computing platform, and execution interact in closed loop. We formalize this as cross-layer variation propagation across these system layers and use an interaction contrast to measure when joint variation creates more risk than the sum of its parts. In 4,000 paired closed-loop episodes of the pi0.5 vision-language-action model on LIBERO, a 400 ms inference delay raises the safety-violation rate by 3.5 percentage points under the training viewpoint but by 37 percentage points under a 60-degree camera shift: 33.5 percentage points (95% CI: 25-43) more than the two effects combined. We close with a research agenda toward predictable physical intelligence: predicting when variation becomes risk, and adapting compute, power, and control accordingly.

[291] D&A: Decoupling Description and Assessment Enables VLMs as Zero-Shot Robotic Reward Models cs.RO | cs.AI | cs.CL | cs.LG | eess.SYPDF

Marius Memmel, Shawn Yin, Urvi Rutia, Angad Wadhwa, Eldon Li

TL;DR: 论文提出 D&A（Describe & Assess），将视觉语言模型（VLM）的零样本机器人任务进度估计解耦为“客观场景动态文本描述”和“基于显式评分标准的评估”两个阶段。该方法先让 VLM 生成任务相关的绝对成功定义，再据此评分，从而避免确认偏差和相对时间排序带来的失败执行进度幻觉。实验表明其能校准零样本估计、提供细粒度部分进度，并在无需训练的情况下匹配或超过后训练奖励模型。

Details

Motivation: 现有 VLM 零样本视频任务进度估计常因隐式成功假设或相对时间排序产生确认偏差，把失败执行误判为有进度；朴素提示又容易退化为二分类成功检测，难以刻画非线性的部分进度和失败。后训练虽可缓解，但需要昂贵真实机器人数据，且对每个基模型都需计算密集的后训练。

Result: 实证结果表明 D&A 能校准零样本估计并缓解确认偏差，给出细粒度的部分进度指标，准确惩罚失败执行并正确插值成功运行。作为纯提示方法，它可跨任务、具身和 benchmark 泛化，匹配或超过后训练奖励模型，其奖励估计还能支持高效的下游强化学习。

Insight: 创新点在于将进度估计解耦为任务 grounding 的客观文本描述与基于显式 rubrics 的评估，并在评分前强制 VLM 合成绝对成功的文本定义，使评估锚定外部全局标准而非视频内部时间线。客观来看，该工作以“描述—评估”解耦和绝对成功锚点缓解确认偏差，同时保持 prompt-only 的低成本与跨模型泛化能力。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) hold promise for zero-shot video task-progress estimation in robot learning, yet existing frameworks frequently suffer from confirmation bias, hallucinating progress in failed executions due to implicit success assumptions or relative temporal ranking designs. Naive prompting of frontier models collapses into a binary success detector that fails to capture nuanced, non-linear progress and failures. While post-training approaches can mitigate this through explicit training, they demand expensive real-world robotics data and require computationally intensive post-training for every individual base model. To resolve these limitations, we introduce D&A (Describe & Assess): our approach decouples progress estimation into an objective, task-grounded textual description of scene dynamics followed by an assessment phase using explicit rubrics. By compelling the VLM to synthesize an explicit, text-based definition of absolute success before scoring, the framework anchors evaluations to an external, global criterion rather than the video’s internal timeline. Empirical results demonstrate that our method calibrates zero-shot estimates and mitigates confirmation bias, providing fine-grained, partial progress metrics that accurately penalize failed executions while correctly interpolating successful runs. Being purely prompt-based, D&A generalizes across tasks, embodiments, and benchmarks—matching or surpassing post-trained reward models—and its reward estimates enable efficient downstream reinforcement learning.

[292] Pixel-UMI: Learning Environment-Aware Whole-Body Manipulation from Sensorized Human Demonstrations cs.RO | cs.AI | cs.CV | cs.LG | eess.SYPDF

Jason Jingzhou Liu, Tony Tao, Deepak Pathak, Ruslan Salakhutdinov

TL;DR: 论文提出 Pixel-UMI，一个从带传感器的人类演示中学习环境感知全身移动操作策略的流程。方法包括环境感知重定向 EAR、延迟校准动作分配、重定向误差感知掩码 REAM，以及通过 DAgger 收集在线人类纠正。最终在五类挑战性操作任务上取得平均 87.0% 的任务进度。

Details

Motivation: 带传感器的人类演示可提供可扩展的移动操作数据，但人机具身差异会导致策略学习困难；重定向残差还会造成人类演示与机器人观测的视角不匹配，且估计动作难以充分覆盖富接触交互。

Result: 在涵盖铰接物体操作、可变形物体处理、受限空间到达、全身避障和富接触双臂协调的五项挑战任务上，平均任务进度达到 87.0%；摘要未明确说明与具体 SOTA 的对比。

Insight: 创新点在于将场景几何与演示轨迹结合进行碰撞感知的全身重定向，并利用重定向误差训练掩码以缓解部署时视角不匹配，同时用 DAgger 在线人类纠正补足富接触交互能力。

Abstract: Sensorized human demonstrations offer scalable data for mobile manipulation, but embodiment differences complicate policy learning. We present Pixel-UMI, a pipeline for learning environment-aware whole-body policies from human data. We first introduce Environment-Aware Retargeting (EAR), which combines reconstructed scene geometry with demonstrated head and gripper trajectories to determine robot posture and generate collision-aware joint and base targets. Delay-calibrated action assignment converts these trajectories into actions. However, kinematic differences can leave residual pose errors, creating viewpoint mismatches between human demonstrations and robot observations. We therefore introduce Retargeting-Error-Aware Masking (REAM), which uses these errors during training to reduce reliance on mismatched views at deployment. Finally, because estimated actions cannot fully capture contact-rich interactions, we collect on-policy human corrections through DAgger to improve performance. We evaluate Pixel-UMI on five challenging tasks spanning articulated-object manipulation, deformable-object handling, constrained-space reaching, whole-body collision avoidance, and contact-rich bimanual coordination, achieving 87.0% average task progress. Video results are available at https://pixel-robot.com/pixel-umi

eess.AS [Back]

[293] Learning Timeline-Preserving Speech-to-Speech Translation eess.AS | cs.CL | cs.SDPDF

Zhisheng Zheng, David Harwath

TL;DR: 论文提出“时间线保持的语音到语音翻译”（timeline-preserving S2ST），要求翻译语音不仅内容与音色相近，还要在共享绝对时间线上保持源语音的端点与显著内部停顿。作者提出端到端自回归系统TransDubber，通过构建642K精确时长匹配的英中语音对，并结合渐进监督课程与验证器引导强化学习，从对齐目标波形中直接学习时间结构，无需推理时帧级时间控制或后处理校正。

Details

Motivation: 现有S2ST越来越能保留“说了什么”和“听起来如何”，但未必保留语音与静音“何时发生”。对于配音等时间敏感应用，仅匹配总时长不够，语音和停顿也需在对应时刻出现，因此需要研究时间线保持的S2ST。

Result: 在涵盖朗读与自发语音的4,353句测试集上，相比UniSS，TransDubber将翻译时长在源时长2%以内的比例从25.6%提升到61.5%，停顿对齐F1从0.118提升到0.550，同时保持有竞争力的翻译质量。

Insight: 论文的创新点包括明确形式化时间线保持S2ST任务，提出无需推理时帧级控制或后处理校正的端到端自回归框架，构建精确时长匹配的监督数据，并用渐进监督课程加验证器引导强化学习平衡翻译质量与时间对齐。可借鉴之处在于用对齐波形监督建立时间线跟随，再以强化学习细化时间精度并缓解严格同步带来的翻译质量损失。

Abstract: Speech-to-speech translation (S2ST) increasingly preserves what is said and how it sounds, but not necessarily when speech and silence occur. For dubbing and other temporally grounded applications, matching total duration is not enough: speech and pauses must also occur at corresponding moments. We formulate timeline-preserving S2ST, which aims to preserve the source endpoint and salient internal pauses on a shared absolute timeline. We present TransDubber, an end-to-end autoregressive system that learns this temporal structure directly from aligned target waveforms, without inference-time frame-level timing control or post-hoc temporal correction. To provide this supervision, we construct 642K exactly duration-matched English-Chinese speech pairs by translating and synthesizing target speech on source-defined temporal scaffolds. Training combines a progressive supervised curriculum with verifier-guided reinforcement learning to balance translation quality and temporal alignment. On a 4,353-utterance test set spanning read and spontaneous speech, TransDubber increases the proportion of translations within 2% of the source duration from 25.6% to 61.5% and pause-alignment F1 from 0.118 to 0.550 compared with UniSS, while maintaining competitive translation quality. Our analysis shows that aligned supervision establishes timeline following, while reinforcement learning refines temporal precision and partially offsets the translation-quality cost of strict synchronization. Together, these results demonstrate the effectiveness of our data and training framework for timeline-preserving S2ST. Audio samples, code, datasets, and pretrained models are available at https://zhishengzheng.com/transdubber/.

TL;DR: 论文针对AVS神经视频压缩（NVC）中的跳过模式编码（skip mode coding），系统分析了其率失真分布随空间和时间参考质量变化的特点，提出率失真优化的RDOSkip框架。该方法利用超先验预测统计分布并结合贝叶斯定理建模率与失真，设计基于时空联合率失真优化的自适应跳过模式决策，用于GOP内通道间和帧间编码。时间跳过模式决策已被AVS NVC标准采纳并集成到参考软件，且无需训练即可推理。

Motivation: 传统视频压缩中的跳过模式在AVS NVC中占据较大编码比例，但现有方法对其率失真性能缺乏研究，且依赖固定跳过阈值和刚性固定失真分布假设，难以适应失真分布的时空变化。

Abstract: With the development of deep learning, neural video compression (NVC) is gaining increasing interest and is currently under standardization in the AVS (Audio Video Coding Standard). Skip mode coding, a crucial component in the traditional video compression, is also adopted in AVS NVC. Although the skip mode takes a large portion in encoding the motion and residual features in the NVC, there is a lack of investigation on the rate distortion performance of the skip mode coding. In this paper, we first thoroughly investigate the rate and distortion distribution in the skip mode coding within a spatial frame and under different temporal reference qualities, and demonstrate that distortion distribution changes spatially and temporally. Therefore, a rate-distortion optimized skip mode coding (RDOSkip) framework is proposed, where the rate and distortion in the skip mode coding is formulated based on a statistical distribution predicted by the hyperprior and the Bayes’ theorem. An adaptive skip mode decision method based on spatial-temporal joint RD optimization is developed for the skip mode coding among channels and frames in a group of pictures. It addresses the limitation of the rigid fixed-distortion distribution assumption in skip mode coding within the existing methods that rely on a fixed skip threshold. The temporal skip mode decision method has been adopted in the ongoing AVS NVC standard and incorporated into the reference software. The proposed RDOSkip can be directly used in the inference without any training and with negligible complexity increase. Experimental results further demonstrate that the proposed RDOSkip can improve the performance by 0.90% and 1.29% on AVS and HEVC datasets, respectively, in terms of BD-rate saving.

Yu-Chen Sun, Jie Dong, Sergey Sablin, Hassene Tmar, Sriram Srinivasan

TL;DR: 论文介绍了VC-1K，一个约1000个视频序列的开源测试集，专为实时通信（RTC）场景下的视频处理和编码评估设计。数据集包含用户生成的视频通话内容，涵盖多种真实条件（设备、光照、运动等），并配有同步音频。论文还通过编码器对比和超分辨率方法评估展示了其效用。

Details

Motivation: 现有测试集多依赖工作室制作或屏幕内容，缺乏真实RTC场景下的用户生成视频数据。VC-1K旨在填补这一空白，提供多样化的真实世界视频通话序列，以更准确地评估RTC中的视频处理和编码流水线。

Result: 论文通过对比OpenH264、SVT-AV1和libaom在恒定比特率下的编码性能，以及评估RealESRGAN和GFPGAN两种超分辨率方法，展示了VC-1K作为基准的实用性，但未报告具体定量结果。

Abstract: We introduce Video Conferencing 1000 (VC-1K), an open-source test set comprising approximately 1,000 video sequences specifically designed for evaluating video processing and encoding pipelines in real-time communication (RTC) scenarios. Unlike existing test sets that primarily rely on studio-produced or screen content, VC-1K consists of user-generated video call content captured on consumer mobile devices under a wide variety of conditions. The dataset predominantly features talking-head sequences with distinct faces, but also includes a small subset of outward-facing, rear-camera videos without faces to reflect additional common RTC use cases. It spans a wide range of real-world variables including device type, lighting conditions, motion levels, indoor/outdoor environments, and demographic diversity. All video sequences are accompanied by synchronous audio to facilitate multimodal research. We detail the dataset’s design methodology and statistical distribution, and demonstrate its utility through a comparative encoder evaluation of OpenH264, SVT-AV1, and libaom under constant bitrate (CBR) encoding at resolutions typical of RTC deployments. Furthermore, two super-resolution approaches, RealESRGAN and GFPGAN, are evaluated on VC-1K, highlighting the dataset as a useful benchmark for pre- and post-processing research. VC-1K is intended to serve as a publicly available dataset for the video RTC research community.

[296] Directional Dual-Head Supervision for Real-Time Source-Free Polyp Segmentation eess.IV | cs.CVPDF

Hai-Dang Nguyen, Nhat-Khoi Le, Huu-Thuan Huynh, Minh-Triet Tran, Trung-Nghia Le
