Abstract: Source-free domain adaptation (SFDA) is critical for medical image segmentation as it adapts a model to an unlabeled target domain without accessing source data, thereby preserving data privacy. However, its effectiveness is often limited by confirmation bias: self-training models tend to miss small polyps, hallucinate foreground, and produce imprecise contours. We propose MedRT-SFSeg, a real-time SFDA framework built on a dual-head one-to-one/one-to-many YOLO segmentation architecture. Mask-DHF fuses precision- and recall-oriented predictions into stable pseudo-instances, while DURR uses the sign of pixel-level dual-head disagreement as a directional cue to expand or shrink masks, and additionally recovers missed instances and suppresses hallucinations. Seg-MARD further regularizes feature representations through mask-guided, region-stratified sampling. Experiments on bidirectional adaptation between Kvasir-SEG and CVC-ClinicDB show that MedRT-SFSeg achieves 80.43%/80.77% Dice and 5.53/8.44 mm ASD, improving the non-adapted baseline by 7.7 and 9.8 Dice points while running at more than 62 FPS end-to-end. These results suggest that segmentation-aware dual-head supervision can improve pseudo-label quality without sacrificing real-time inference. Project page: https://danielnguyen-05.github.io/MedRT-SFSeg

[297] The MASSIMAL Dataset: UAV Hyperspectral Images and Ground Truth Observations for Coastal Habitat Mapping in Norway eess.IV | cs.CVPDF

Martin Hansen Skjelvareid, Eli Rinde, Kasper Hancke, Katalin Blix, Galice Guillaume Hoarau

TL;DR: 论文介绍了面向挪威浅海沿岸生境制图的多模态遥感数据集 MASSIMAL，核心是 UAV 高光谱影像及配套标注、RGB/多光谱影像、影像镶嵌和多种水下/声呐地面真值数据。数据集覆盖挪威海岸 4 个区域、45 次飞行，高光谱影像空间分辨率 3.5 cm、400-1000 nm 共 300 个波段，约 1000 幅高光谱影像中 221 幅带分割掩码和层级分类标注，并提供开源反射率与耀斑校正处理流程。

Details

Motivation: 论文旨在为海带林、海草床和 maerl 床等浅水沿岸生境制图提供新的遥感方法基础数据，支持生境分布评估、变化监测和生态系统服务评价，从而服务于挪威沿岸环境的循证管理。

Result: 论文主要贡献是数据集构建而非方法性能评测；摘要给出了数据规模与规格：45 次 UAV 飞行、4 个区域、纬度 59°-67°N、3.5 cm 地面采样距离、400-1000 nm/300 波段、约 1000 幅高光谱影像中 221 幅已标注，并包含 RGB、多光谱、镶嵌图及水下视频、图像和单波束声呐等地面真值。未提及在具体 benchmark 上达到 SOTA 或与某模型对比的定量结果。

Insight: 创新点在于构建面向沿岸生境制图的 UAV 高光谱多模态数据集，提供层级分类体系下的分割标注、耀斑校正与反射率生成的开源处理流程，并融合水下视频、图像和声呐等多源地面真值，为遥感生境制图与变化监测提供可复用数据基础。

Abstract: The MASSIMAL dataset was collected in an effort to develop new remote sensing methods for mapping shallow water coastal habitats, such as kelp forests, seagrass meadows and maerl beds. The main component of the dataset is a set of hyperspectral images collected using a unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV). Images were collected during 45 UAV flights performed at 4 main areas along the Norwegian coast, spanning across a wide latitude range, from 59 to 67 degrees north. The ground sampling distance of the hyperspectral images is 3.5 cm, and the spectral range is 400-1000 nm, sampled across 300 spectral bands. During acquisition, push-broom imagery was automatically split into images with a maximum along-track length of 2000 lines. Out of approximately 1000 hyperspectral images, 221 have been annotated, using segmentation masks and a hierarchical taxonomy. An open source image processing pipeline has been developed as part of the dataset preparation, enabling efficient generation of reflectance images and glint-corrected images based on published radiance images. The dataset also includes color images (RGB) and multispectral images collected using UAV, and georeferenced image mosaics constructed from these. Ground truth data supporting the remote sensing images include hours of underwater video, thousands of geotagged underwater images, and tens of kilometers of single-beam sonar data. The data provide a foundation for assessing habitat distribution, tracking changes, and evaluating ecosystem services, thus supporting evidence-based management in Norwegian coastal environments.

[298] Spectral-spatial vision test-time training for hyperspectral image classification eess.IV | cs.CVPDF

Xiang Zhao

TL;DR: 论文提出ViTTT-HSI，将视觉测试时训练（ViT3）架构适配到高光谱图像分类：用光谱感知嵌入stem提取有序波段信息并保持空间分辨率，通过两个ViT3 TTT编码器块进行patch-conditioned token mixing，并融合中心像素与邻域平均特征进行分类。方法在四个高光谱数据集上验证，取得较高总体精度，并通过消融分析TTT内更新、光谱stem和特征融合的贡献。

Details

Motivation: 高光谱图像分类依赖有限标注下的连续光谱签名与空间上下文表示；视觉TTT虽能通过自监督内模型更新替代固定权重token mixing，但其在中心像素高光谱分类中的应用尚未被充分刻画。

Result: 在Indian Pines、Pavia University、Salinas和Houston 2013上，使用10个随机种子及1%或5%训练比例，平均总体精度分别为97.6390%、98.8753%、99.3292%和98.4283%；消融显示TTT内更新在Indian Pines贡献显著，在Pavia University为较小正贡献，光谱stem与特征融合的收益依数据集而异。

Insight: 创新点在于将ViT3式视觉测试时训练适配到高光谱光谱-空间分类，设计光谱感知嵌入stem保持空间分辨率，并采用patch-conditioned token mixing及中心像素与邻域特征融合。客观看，其价值主要在系统验证内适应机制对HSI分类的可行性和数据集依赖性。

Abstract: Hyperspectral image (HSI) classification requires the representation of contiguous spectral signatures and spatial context under limited labeled supervision. Vision test-time training (TTT) offers an alternative to fixed-weight token mixing by performing self-supervised inner-model updates on the input sequence, but its application to center-pixel HSI classification remains insufficiently characterized. We present ViTTT-HSI, a spectral-spatial adaptation of the vision test-time training (ViT3) architecture. A spectral-aware embedding stem extracts ordered-band information using spectral convolution and forms spatial tokens without reducing their spatial resolution. Two ViT3-based TTT encoder blocks perform patch-conditioned token mixing, followed by the fusion of center-pixel and neighborhood-average features for classification. We evaluate the framework on Indian Pines, Pavia University, Salinas, and Houston 2013 using ten random seeds and dataset-specific training fractions of 1% or 5%. The mean overall accuracies are 97.6390%, 98.8753%, 99.3292%, and 98.4283%, respectively. Ablations reveal a substantial contribution from the TTT inner update on Indian Pines and a smaller positive contribution on Pavia University, while the relative benefits of the spectral stem and feature fusion depend on the dataset. The results demonstrate the feasibility of using patch-conditioned vision TTT for spectral–spatial HSI classification and highlight the role of the inner adaptation mechanism.

[299] HIVE-Diff: High Frame Rate HDR Video Reconstruction from a Single LDR Frame and Events eess.IV | cs.CVPDF

Caixin Wang, Qingrui Wang, Jie Zhang, Ralph Etienne-Cummings

TL;DR: 论文研究从单帧LDR参考和事件流重建高帧率HDR视频，提出HIVE-Diff事件条件视频扩散框架，将任务分解为事件引导的时间生成与HDR内容补全，并利用合成数据训练及教师-学生蒸馏适配真实事件域。

Details

Motivation: 传统帧相机在时间分辨率与动态范围之间存在权衡，事件相机可提供高速、宽动态的亮度变化信息；但纯事件HDR重建存在亮度与颜色漂移，现有事件-帧混合方法多只在LDR时间戳做一对一重建，缺少单参考下的HDR时间扩展。

Result: 在合成数据集和多个真实世界数据集上实验表明方法具有较强重建质量和鲁棒的真实数据适配能力；摘要未给出具体定量指标或明确SOTA结论。

Insight: 创新点在于提出单LDR参考加事件的HDR时序扩展设定，用事件条件视频扩散分解时间生成与HDR补全，并通过合成训练加LDR-事件代理监督蒸馏缓解真实HDR-事件配对数据稀缺问题。

Abstract: High frame rate HDR video is important in applications such as autonomous driving and scientific imaging, where rapid motion and extreme illumination often occur simultaneously. Conventional frame cameras face a trade-off between temporal resolution and dynamic range, while event cameras provide complementary high-speed brightness-change measurements over a wide illumination range. These properties have motivated event-based HDR reconstruction, with existing methods broadly following event-only and hybrid event-frame paradigms. Event-only HDR reconstruction, however, suffers from brightness and color drift due to the lack of absolute intensity references. Hybrid event-frame methods alleviate this ambiguity using low-dynamic-range (LDR) frames as anchors, but most perform one-to-one HDR reconstruction at available LDR timestamps. In this work, we investigate single-reference HDR temporal expansion, reconstructing N HDR frames from one LDR reference and events instead of N aligned LDR observations. We develop HIVE-Diff, an event-conditioned video diffusion framework that decomposes the task into event-guided temporal generation and HDR content completion. Because paired real HDR-event data are scarce, we train on synthetic data and adapt the model to real event domains using LDR-event sequences as proxy supervision with teacher-student distillation. Experiments on synthetic and multiple real-world datasets demonstrate strong reconstruction quality and robust real-data adaptation.

eess.SY [Back]

[300] Vision-based Sensing of Urban Environment using Hardware-Software co-design at Scale eess.SY | cs.CVPDF

Akshit Gupta, R Venkatesha Prasad

TL;DR: 论文提出 UrbanScapes，一个面向大规模城市环境视觉感知的软硬件协同设计平台。该平台采用模块化架构，集成 RGB、近红外和热成像等多光谱成像通道，支持在自行车、车辆、行人或市政车队上灵活部署，以采集街道级多光谱图像；同时利用边缘端深度学习自动去除个人可识别信息，并将街道级多光谱数据与高空遥感多光谱数据结合，用于可扩展地计算物理环境指数。

Details

Motivation: 现有城市环境监测主要依赖人工巡检、高空遥感和有限的地面 RGB 图像，缺乏街道级综合多光谱视角，且街道级数据采集面临隐私和大规模部署难题。论文旨在构建可扩展、无需硬件重设计的软硬件协同平台来弥补这一空白。

Result: 摘要未报告具体定量结果、基准测试或 SOTA 对比，主要介绍了平台的多光谱采集、灵活部署、边缘隐私保护和与遥感数据融合的能力。

Insight: 论文宣称的创新点在于多光谱街道级感知的软硬件协同与模块化设计、支持机会式和定向式大规模部署、边缘端 PII 自动去除，以及融合地面多光谱与高空遥感数据计算环境指数。客观来看，其创新更偏向系统集成与可扩展部署框架，而非单一算法突破。

Abstract: Urban environmental monitoring is crucial for climate-adaptive cities, yet current approaches rely heavily on human inspection, overhead remote sensing, or limited terrestrial RGB imagery, thereby lacking comprehensive multispectral perspectives at street level. To bridge this gap, this paper introduces UrbanScapes, an adaptable and flexible hardware-software co-design platform for large-scale, vision-based sensing of urban environments. Built on a modular architecture, UrbanScapes seamlessly integrates multispectral imaging channels, including Red, Green, Blue (RGB), Near-Infrared, and Thermal, to capture multispectral street-level imagery. The system is designed for both opportunistic deployment on bicycles, vehicles, or pedestrians and targeted deployments on municipal fleets, ensuring high spatio-temporal scalability without requiring hardware redesigns. Crucially, the platform utilizes on-device deep learning models to automatically remove personally identifiable information (PII) at the edge, addressing privacy concerns inherent in street-level data collection. By combining this multispectral street-level imagery with overhead multispectral remote sensing imagery, UrbanScapes enables scalable calculation of physics-based environmental indices, providing a foundational tool for advanced citywide analysis.

q-bio.NC [Back]

[301] Geometric and algebraic inference in humans and neural networks q-bio.NC | cs.AI | cs.CL | cs.LGPDF

Jacob Russin, Joonhwa Kim, Ellie Pavlick, Michael J. Frank

TL;DR: 论文提出将有限数据下的推断形式化为几何推断与代数推断两种策略：前者通过逐步塑造表征几何来编码关系结构，使后续推断更省计算；后者在推理时灵活关注并处理上下文中的新关系，但计算成本更高。作者在传递性推断任务中识别二者的相反特征，并在人类、从头训练的神经网络和大型语言模型中验证，还通过因果干预揭示其分别依赖表征几何和选择性注意机制。

Details

Motivation: 论文关注人类如何从有限数据中进行推断，以及直觉性经验推断与基于上下文新信息的在线推理之间的计算权衡；目标是形式化几何与代数两种策略，并解释人类和神经网络在不同条件下表现出的推理行为。

Result: 摘要未给出具体数值或benchmark/SOTA结果；作者通过多个实验在人类、从头训练神经网络和LLM中观察到两类策略的相反特征，并用神经网络因果干预表明几何策略依赖表征几何、代数策略依赖选择性注意，且可复现人类类似神经生物学干扰效应。

Insight: 创新点在于提出几何/代数推断的统一框架，将认知灵活性中“表征几何”与“代数操作”两种观点联系起来，并用因果干预把策略差异映射到表征几何和选择性注意机制；该框架还能统一人类与LLM推理中的内容效应及机器学习中的数据分布效应。

Abstract: Humans possess a remarkable ability to draw inferences from limited data. While some inferences are made intuitively from past experience, others require online reasoning based on novel information given in context. Here, we formalize these strategies, which we term geometric and algebraic inference, and study their computational tradeoffs in humans and neural networks. The geometric strategy gradually shapes representational geometry to reflect underlying relational structure, making subsequent inference cheap. The algebraic strategy flexibly attends to and reasons over novel relations given in context, but costs additional computation at inference time. We identify opposing signatures of these two strategies in transitive inference, a domain widely studied across species, and characterize the conditions under which each is observed. Our framework predicts that the geometric strategy should be dominant when relations are familiar, whereas the algebraic should emerge to support de novo inferences drawn in context. Multiple experiments demonstrate these opposing signatures in humans, neural networks trained from scratch, and large language models (LLMs). Causal interventions in the neural networks reveal that the geometric and algebraic strategies depend on representational geometry and selective attention mechanisms, respectively, and reproduce the effects of analogous neurobiological disruptions in humans. Our framework unifies these effects with disparate phenomena, including content effects observed in human and LLM reasoning and data-distribution effects observed in machine learning. Our findings reconcile competing views of cognitive flexibility that emphasize either representational geometry or algebraic manipulation by showing that each can have unique strengths, and can characterize different aspects of both human and neural network behavior.
